a: Mashkin bet hashshelachin bammoed uvashsheviit, ben mimmayayn sheyyatza battechilla, ben mimmayayn shello yatza battechilla. aval en mashkin lo mimme haggeshamim, velo mimme hakkilon.

Veen osin ugiyyot laggefanim. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: en osin et haamma battechilla bammoed uvishviit, vachachamim omrim: osin et haamma battechilla bashsheviit, umetakkenin et hamekulekalot bammoed.

Umetakkenin et kilkule hammayim shebbirshut harabbim, vechottin otan, umetakkenin et hadderachim veet harchovot veet mikvot hammayim, veosin kol tzorche harabbim, umetzayyeynin et hakkevarot, veyotzin af al hakkilayim.
Gemara hasheta yesh lomar mimmayayn sheyyatza battechilla, deate leinnefole — mashkin, mimmayayn shello yatza battechilla, dela ate leinnefole — mibbaya?

Amri, itzterich: i tanna mayayn sheyyatza battechilla, hava amena: hacha hu devet hashshelachin — in, bet habbaal — la, mishshum deate leinnefole. aval mayayn shello yatza battechilla, dela ate leinnefole — ema afillu bet habbaal name,
Ka mashma lan: la shena mayayn sheyyatza battechilla, vela shena mayayn shello yatza battechilla, bet hashshelachin — in, bet habbaal — la.
Umay mashma dehay "bet hashshelachin" lishshana detzachuta hi — dichtiv: "veatta ayef veyagea", umetargeminan: veat meshalhe ulee.
Umay mashma dehay "bet habbaal" lishshana dimyaytvuta hi — dichtiv: "ki yival bachur betula", umetargeminan: are kamma demittotav ulem im betuleta yityaytvun begavvich benayich.
Man tanna difseda — in, harevavcha — la, vaafillu bimkom peseda — mitrach name la tarchinan?
Amar rav huna: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi. ditnan, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: moshchin et hammayim meilan leilan, uvilvad shello yashke et hassade kullah.
Emor deshamat leh lerabbi eliezer harevavcha dela, tircha bimkom peseda mi shamat leh?

Ella amar rav pappa: ha manni — rabbi yehuda hi, detanya: mayayn hayyotze battechilla — mashkin mimmennu afillu sede bet habbaal, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: en mashkin ella sede bet hashshelachin shecharva. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: lo kach velo kach. yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda: lo yafne adam ammat hammayim veyashke leginnato ulechurebato bechullo shel moed.
May "charva"? illema charva mammash, lema li demashke la? amar abbaye: shecharva mimmayayn ze veyatza lah mayayn acher.
Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer lo kach velo kach, la shena charav mayaynah vela shena lo charav mayaynah — mayayn sheyyatza battechilla la.
Umimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda: bet hashshelachin — in, bet habbaal — la, ella mayayn sheyyatza battechilla
b: Dilma ate leinnefole. aval mayayn shello yatza battechilla, dela ate leinnefole — afillu bet habbaal name!

Im ken — matnitin amman tirmeyay? ella: lerabbi yehuda la shena mayayn sheyyatza battechilla, vela shena mayayn shello yatza battechilla, bet hashshelachin — in, bet habbaal — la. vehay dekatane mayayn sheyyatza battechilla, lehodiacha kocho derabbi meir, daafillu mayayn hayyotze battechilla — mashkin mimmennu afillu sede habbaal.
Ittemar: hamenakkesh vehammashke mayim lizraim beshabbat, mishshum may matrinan beh? rabba amar: mishshum choresh. rav yosef amar: mishshum zorea.

Amar rabba, kevoti didi mistabbera: ma darko shel choresh — lerappoye ara, hay name merappevyy ara. amar rav yosef, kevoti didi mistabbera: ma darko shel zorea — letzammoche pera, hacha name metzammach pera.
Amar leh abbaye lerabba: ledidach kashya ulerav yosef kashya. ledidach kashya: mishshum choresh in, mishshum zorea la? lerav yosef kashya: mishshum zorea in, mishshum choresh la?
Vechi tema: kol hecha deikka tarte la michayyayv ella chada, vehaamar rav kahana: zomer vetzarich laetzim — chayyayv shetayim. achat mishshum notea, veachat mishshum kotzer.
Kashya.
Etiveh rav yosef lerabba: hamenakkesh vehamechappe lechilayim loke. rabbi akiva omer: af hamekayyem.
Bishlama ledidi, deamena mishshum zorea — hayeynu daasira zeria bechilayim, ella ledidach, deamrat mishshum choresh — charisha bechilayim mi asira?
Amar leh: mishshum mekayyem.
Veha middekatane sefa: rabbi akiva omer af hamekayyem, mikkelal detanna kamma lav mishshum mekayyem hu!
Kulla rabbi akiva hi, umay taam" kaamar: may taam hamenakkesh vehamechappe bechilayim loke mishshum mekayyem — sherabbi akiva omer: af hamekayyem.
May tama derabbi akiva? detanya: "sadcha lo tizra kilayim", en li ella zorea, mekayyem minnayin?
Talmud lomar: "kilayim sadcha lo".
Tenan: mashkin bet hashshelachin bammoed uvishviit.
Bishlama moed, mishshum tircha hu, uvimkom peseda sharu rabbanan. ella sheviit, ben leman deamar mishshum zorea uven leman deamar mishshum choresh, zeria vacharisha bishviit mi shere?
Amar abbaye: bishviit bizman hazze, verabbi hi. detanya, rabbi omer: "veze devar hashshemitta shamot". bishte shemitot hakkatuv medabber, achat shemittat karka, veachat shemittat kesafim.
Bizman sheatta meshammet karka — atta meshammet kesafim, uvizman shei atta meshammet karka — i atta meshammet kesafim.
Rava amar: afillu tema rabbanan — avot asar rachamana,

a: Toladot la asar rachamana. dichtiv: "uvashshana hashsheviit shabbat shabbaton yihye laaretz sadcha lo tizra vegomer".
Mikkede, zemira bichlal zeria, uvetzira bichlal ketzira. lemay hilcheta katvinhu rachamana?
Lememra deahane toladot michayyayv, aachranyayta la michayyayv.

Vela? vehatanya: "sadcha lo tizra vecharmecha lo tizmor". en li ella zerua vezimmur, minnayin lenikkush uleiddur ulechissuach — talmud lomar: "sadcha lo", "karmecha lo". lo kol melacha shebbesadcha, velo kol melacha shebbecharmecha.
Minnayin sheen mekarsemin veen mezardin veen mefassegin bailan? talmud lomar: "sadcha lo", "karmecha lo". lo kol melacha shebbesadcha, velo kol melacha shebbecharmecha.
Minnayin sheen mezabbelin veen mefarkin veen meabbekin veen meashshenin bailan? talmud lomar: "sadcha lo", "karmecha lo". kol melacha shebbesadcha lo, vechol melacha shebbecharmecha lo.
Yachol lo yekashkesh tachat hazzetim, velo yeadder tachat haggefanim, velo yemalle nekaim mayim, velo yaase ugiyyot laggefanim — talmud lomar: "sadcha lo tizra".
Zeria bakkelal hayta, velamma yatzta — lehakkish eleha, lomar lecha: ma zeria meyuchedet avoda shebbassade veshebbakkerem, af kol shehi avoda shebbassade veshebbakkerem!
Midderabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma.
Vekishkush bishviit mi shere? veha ketiv: "vehashsheviit tishmetenna unetashtah" — "tishmetenna" millekashkesh, "unetashtah" millesakkel!
Amar rav ukeva bar chama: tere kishkushe havu. chad avroye ilane, vechad sattome pile. avroye ilan — asur, sattome pile — shere.

Ittemar: hachoresh bashsheviit, rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar, chad amar: loke, vechad amar: eno loke. lema bidrabbi avin amar rabbi ila kamippalgi. deamar rabbi avin amar rabbi ila: kol makom shenneemar kelal baase uferat belo taase — en danin oto bichlal uferat uchelal.
Man deamar loke — let leh derabbi avin amar rabbi ila.
Uman deamar eno loke — it leh derabbi avin.
La, dechulle alma let leh derabbi avin amar rabbi ila, man deamar loke — shappir.
Uman deamar eno loke, amar lach: mikkedi zemira bichlal zeria uvetzira bichlal ketzira, lemay hilcheta katvinhu rachamana? lememar deahane toladot hu demichayyayv, attolada acharina la michayyayv.

Vela? vehatanya: "sadcha lo tizra vecharmecha lo tizmor", en li ella zerua vezimmur. minyan leiddur ulekishkush ulechissuach? talmud lomar: "sadcha lo", "karmecha lo". lo kol melacha shebbesadcha velo kol melacha shebbecharmecha.
Uminnayin sheen mekarsemin, veen mezardin, veen mefassegin bailan talmud lomar: "sadcha lo", "karmecha lo": kol melacha shebbesadcha lo kol melacha shebbecharmecha lo.
Minnayin sheen mezabbelin veen mefarkin veen meashshenin bailan? talmud lomar: "sadcha lo", "karmecha lo". kol melacha shebbesadcha lo, vechol melacha shebbecharmecha lo.
Yachol lo yekashkesh tachat hazzetim, velo yeadder tachat haggefanim, velo yemalle nekaim mayim, velo yaase ugiyyot laggefanim — talmud lomar: "sadcha lo tizra".
Zeria bakkelal hayta, velamma yatzta — lehakkish eleha, lomar lach: ma zeria meyuchedet avoda shebbassade veshebbakkerem, af kol shehi avoda shebbassade veshebbakkerem!
Midderabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma.
b: Ki ata rav dimi, amar: yachol yilke al hattosefet. venasev la talmuda liftura, vela yadana may talmuda umay tosefet.
Rabbi elazar amar: charisha. vehachi kaamar: yachol yilke al charisha deatya mikkelal uferat uchelal, venasev leh talmuda liftura.
Deim ken, kol hane perate lema li?

Verabbi yochanan amar: yamim shehosifu chachamim lifne rosh hashshana. vehachi kaamar: yachol yilke al tosefet rosh hashshana, deatya "mibbecharish uvakkatzir tishbot", venasev la talmuda liftura, kidvaenan lememar lekamman.

May yamim shellifne rosh hashshana, keditnan: ad matay chorshin bisde ilan erev sheviit? bet shammay omrim: kol zeman sheyyafe lapperi — uvet hillel omrim: ad haatzeret. ukerovin divre ellu lihyot kedivre ellu.
Vead matay chorshin sede hallavan erev sheviit? mishshettichle hallecha, vechol zeman shebbene adam chorshim litta mikshaot umidlaot.
Rabbi shimon omer: im ken natna tora shiur lechol echad veechad beyado. ella: bisde hallavan — ad happesach, uvisde hailan — ad haatzeret. uvet hillel omrim: ad happesach.
Veamar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: rabban gamliel uvet dino nimnu al shene perakim hallalu, uvittelum.

Amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi avahu, veamri la resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: rabban gamliel uvet dino hechi matzu mevatteli takkanta devet shammay uvet hillel? veha tenan: en bet din yachol levattel divre bet din chavero ella im ken gadol mimmennu bechachma uveminyan!
"Eshtomam keshaa chada". amar leh: emor, kach hitnu benehen: kol harotze levattel — yavo vivattel.
Didhu hi? halacha lemoshe missinay hi! deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi nechuneya ish bikat bet chortan: eser netiot, arava, venissuch hammayim, halacha lemoshe missinay!
Amar rabbi yitzchak: ki gemiri hilcheta, sheloshim yom lifne rosh hashshana, vaato hane takkun mippesach umeatzeret, veatno bedidhu: kol harotze levattel yavo vivattel.

Vehane hilcheta ninhu? kerae ninhu, ditnan: "becharish uvakkatzir tishbot", rabbi akiva omer: en tzarich lomar charish vekatzir shel sheviit, shehare kevar neemar: "sadcha lo tizra vecharmecha lo tizmor", ella charish shel erev sheviit

a: Shennichnas lishviit, vekatzir shel sheviit sheyyatza lemotzae sheviit.
Rabbi yishmael omer: ma charish reshut, af katzir — reshut, yatza ketzir haomer shehi mitzva!
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ki gemiri hilcheta — lemishre yalda. kerae — lemesar zekena.
Vechevan dehilcheta lemishre yalda, lav mimmela zekena asira?!
Ella: hilcheta lerabbi yishmael, kerae lerabbi akiva.
Verabbi yochanan amar: rabban gamliel uvet dino middeorayyta battul lehu.
May tama? gamar "shabbat" "shabbat" mishshabbat bereshit. ma lehallan — hi asura lefaneha uleachareha muttarin, af kan — hi asura lefaneha uleachareha muttarin.
Matkef la rav ashe: man deamar hilcheta — atya gezera shava akra hilcheta? uman deamar kera — atya gezera shava akra kera?

Ella amar rav ashe: rabban gamliel uvet dino savri la kerabbi yishmael, deamar hilcheta gemiri la. vechi gemiri hilcheta, bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym — dumeya denissuch hammayim. aval bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym — la.
Aval lo mimme haggeshamim umimme hakkilon. bishlama me kilon — ikka tircha yattira, ella me geshamim may tircha ikka?
Amar rabbi ila amar yochanan: gezera me geshamim attu me kilon. rav ashe amar: me geshamim gufayyhu lide me kilon atu.
Vekamippalgi bidrabbi zera. deamar rabbi zera amar rabba bar yirmeya amar shemuel: neharot hammoshchin mayim min haagammim muttar lehashekot mehen bechullo shel moed.
Mar it leh derabbi zera, umar let leh derabbi zera.
Gufa, amar rabbi zera amar rabba bar yirmeya amar shemuel: neharot hammoshchin mayim min haagammim — muttar lehashekot mehen bechullo shel moed.
Etiveh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: aval lo mimme geshamim velo mimme kilon! amar leh: yirmeya beri, hane aggammim devavel — kemayya dela paski damu.
Tanu rabbanan: happesikot vehabberechot shennitmalleu mayim meerev yom tov — asur lehashekot mehen bechullo shel moed. veim hayta ammat hammayim overet benehen — muttar.

Amar rav pappa: vehu sherubbah shel otah sade shota meotah ammat hammayim. rav ashe amar: af al pi sheen rubbah shel otah sade shota, kevan deka mashcha veatya, memar amar: i la shatya lechad yoma — tishte litre utelata yome.
Tanu rabbanan: berecha shennotefet mayim missede bet hashshelachin zo — muttar lehashekot mimmenna sede bet hashshelachin acheret.
Veha avida defaska! amar rabbi yirmeya: vaadayin hi metaftefet. amar abbaye: vehu shello pasak mayayn rishon.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben menasya omer: shete arugot zo lemala mizzo — lo yidle min hattachtona veyashke et haelyona. yoter al ken amar rabbi elazar bar shimon: afillu aruga achat chetzyah namuch vechetzyah gavoah — lo yidle mimmakom namuch veyashke lemakom gavoah.
Tanu rabbanan: madlin lirakot kede leochlan, veim bishvil leyaypotan — asur.

Ravina verabba tosfaa havo ka azli beorcha. chazo lehahu gavra dahava dale davvla bechulla demoada, amar leh rabba tosfaa leravina: lete mar leshammeteh. amar leh: vehatanya: madlin lirakot kede leochlan. amar leh: mi savrat may "madlin" — madlin mayya? may
b: "Madlin" — shallofe. keditnan: hammedel baggefanim, keshem shehu medel beshello — kach hu medel beshel aniyyim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: beshello rashshay, veeno rashshay beshel aniyyim.
Amar leh, vehatanya: madlin mayim lirakot kede leochlan! amar leh: i tanya — tanya.
Veen osin ugiyyot laggefanim. may ugiyyot? amar rav yehuda: banke. tanya name hachi: ellu hen ugiyyot — bedidin shebbeikkare zetim veshebbeikkare gefanim.
Ini? veha rav yehuda shera livne bar tzetay lemebad banke lecharmehon! la kashya ha bechadte, ha beattike.
Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: en osin et haamma. bishlama moed — mishshum deka tarach, ella sheviit may tama?
Peligu ba rabbi zera verabbi abba bar memel. chad amar: mippene shennire keoder. vechad amar: mippene shemmachshir agappeha lizria.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deka atu mayya batreh. man deamar mippene shemmachshir agappeha lizria — ikka, uman deamar mippene shennire keoder — lekka.

Uleman deamar mippene shennire keoder, lechush mippene shemmachshir agappeha lizria? ella, ikka benayyhu deka shakel minneh veshade levaray. leman deamar mippene shemmachshir agappeha lizria — lekka. leman deamar mippene shennire keoder — ikka.
Uleman deamar mippene shemmachshir agappeha lizria, lechush mippene shennire keoder! oder name, ki ka shakel, beducheteh mannach leh.
Ammemar matne la mippene shennire keoder, vekashya leh derabbi elazar ben azarya adderabbi elazar ben azarya: umi amar rabbi elazar ben azarya kol shennire keoder asur?
Ureminhi: ose adam et zivlo otzar. rabbi meir oser, ad sheyyaamik shelosha tefachim, o ad sheyyagbiah shelosha tefachim. haya lo davar muat — mosif alav veholech.
Rabbi elazar ben azarya oser ad sheyyamik shelosha o ad sheyyagbiah shelosha, o ad sheyyitten al hassela!
Rabbi zera verabbi abba bar memel, chad amar: kegon sheheemik, vechad amar: zivlo mochiach alav.
Umetakkenin et hamekulekelet bammoed. may mekulekelet? amar rabbi abba: sheim hayta amukka tefach — maamidah al shishsha tefachim.
Peshita, chatzi tefach al shelosha tefachim, kevan dela avar mayya — la kelum hu. tifchayim al shenem asar, deka tarach tircha yattira — la.
Tifchayim al shiva mahu? hacha chamishsha ka maamek, vehacha chamishsha ka maamek, o dilma: kevan deikka tefach yattira — ikka tircha tefe? teku.

Abbaye shera livne bar hamedach leshachofe nahara. rabbi yirmeya shera lehu livne sachuta lemichre nahara temima. rav ashe shera lehu livne mata machseya leakdoche nehar burenitz. amar: kevan deshatu minneh rabbim — kerabbim dame, utenan: osin kol tzorche rabbim.
Umetakkenin et

a: Kilkule hammayim shebbirshut harabbim vechulei. chatita — in, chafira — la.
Amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella sheen rabbim tzerichin lahem, aval rabbim tzerichin lahem — afillu chafira muttar.

Vechi rabbim tzerichin lahem mi shere? vehatanya: chottin borot shichin umearot shel yachid, veen tzarich lomar shel rabbim, veen chofrin borot shichin umearot shel rabbim, veen tzarich lomar shel yachid. may lav, besherabbim tzerichin lahem?!
La, besheen rabbim tzerichin lahem.

Dichvota gabbe yachid, sheen yachid tzarich lahem, chatita mi shere? vehatanya: borot shichin umearot shel yachid — konsin mayim letochan, aval lo chottin velo shafin et sidkehen. veshel rabbim — chottin otan veshafin et sidkehen.

Veella may — besheyyachid tzarich lahem? dichvota gabbe rabbim, besherabbim tzerichin lahem, chafira mi asir? vehatanya: borot shichin umearot shel yachid — konsin mayim letochan vechottin otan, aval lo shafin et sidkehen, velo chottin letochan, velo sadin otan besid. veshel rabbim — chofrin otan, vesadin otan besid!
Ella kashya hach kammayyta! taretz hachi: chottin borot shel yachid besheyyachid tzarich lahem, veen tzarich lomar beshel rabbim kesherabbim tzerichin lahem, daafillu chafira muttar.
Veen chofrin borot shichin umearot shel rabbim — besheen rabbim tzerichin lahem, veen tzarich lomar shel yachid, dechi en yachid tzarich lahem — afillu chatita name asur.
Amar rav ashe: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: osin kol tzorche rabbim, "kol" leetoye may — lav leetoye chafira?
La, leetoye ha detanya: yotzin lekavvevtz et hadderachim, uletakken et harchovot veet haisterataot, velamod et hammikvaot. vechol mikve sheen bo arbaim sea margilin letocho, arbaim sea.
Uminnayin sheim lo yatzu veasu kol ellu, shekkol damim shennishpechu sham maale alehem hakkatuv keillu hem shefachum — talmud lomar: "vehaya alecha damim".
Ha behedya katane la: umetakkenin et hadderachim veet harchovot veet hammikvaot. veosin kol tzorche rabbim leetoye may — lav leetoye chafira? shema minna.
Metzayyenin et hakkevarot. amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi: remez letziyyun kevarot min hattora minnayin, talmud lomar: "veraa etzem adam uvana etzlo tziyyun".

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: ha mikkamme delete yechezkel, man amar? velitamaych, ha deamar rav chisda: davar ze, mittorat moshe rabbenu lo lamadnu, middivre yechezkel ben buzi lamadnu: "kol ben nechar erel lev veerel basar lo yavo el mikdashi lesharteni" —
Mikkamme delete yechezkel, man amar? ella gemara gemiri la vaata yechezkel veasmecha akkera, hacha name: gemara gemiri la, vaata yechezkel veasmecha akkera.
Rabbi avahu amar, mehacha: "vetame tame yikra" — tumea kora lo veomeret lo "perosh". vechen amar rabbi uzziel bar bereh derabbi uzziel rabba: tumea korah lo veomeret lo "perosh".
Vehay lehachi hu daata? hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya: "vetame tame yikra". tzarich lehodia tzaaro lerabbim, verabbim mevakkeshin alav rachamim!
Im ken, lichtov: "vetame yikra", may "vetame tame" — shamat minna tarte.
Abbaye amar, mehacha: "velifne ivver lo titten michshol". rav pappa amar: "veamar sollu sollu pannu darech".
Rav chinnana amar: "harimu michshol midderech ammi". rabbi yehoshua bereh derav idi amar: "vehodata lahem et hadderech asher yelchu vah".
Mar zutera amar: "vehizzartem et bene yisrael mittumeatam". rav ashe amar: "ushemartem et mishmarti" — asu mishmeret lemishmarti.
Ravina amar: "vesam derech arennu beyesha elohim".
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hashsham orchotav — zoche veroe bishuato shel hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "vesam derech", al tikre "vesam", ella: "vesham derech" — "arennu beyesha elohim".
Rabbi yannay hava leh hahu talmida dechol yoma hava makshe leh, beshabbeta derigla la hava makshe leh,
b: Kare aleh: "vesam derech arennu beyesha elohim".

Tanu rabbanan: en metzayyenin lo al kazzayit min hammet, velo al etzem kisora, velo al davar sheeno metamme beohel. aval metzayyenin al hashshidra, veal haggulegolet, al rov binyan, veal rov minyan hammet.

Veen metzayyenin al havvavdaot, aval metzayyenin al hassefekot. veellu hen hassefekot: sechachot uferaot uvet happeras. veen maamidin tziyyun bimkom tumea, shello lehafesid et hatteharot. veen marchikin tziyyun mimmekom tumea, shello lehafesid et eretz yisrael.
Uchezayit min hammet eno metamme beohel? veha tenan: ellu shemmetammein beohel — kezayit min hammet!
Amar rav pappa: hacha bichzayit metzumetzam askinan, desof sof michsar chasar. mutav yissarfu alav teruma vekodashim lefi shaa, veal yissarfu alav leolam.
Veellu hen hassefekot: sechachot uferaot.
Sechachot — ilan hammesech al haaretz.
Peraot — avanim peruot hayyotzot min haggader.
Bet happeras, keditnan: hachoresh et hakkever hare hu ose bet happeras, vechamma hu ose — melo maane mea amma.
Uvet happeras mi metamme beohel? vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: menappeach adam bet happeras veholech.
Verav yehuda bar amme mishshemeh deulla amar: bet happeras shenniddash — tahor!
Amar rav pappa, la kashya: kan besade sheavad bah kever, kan besade shennechrash bah kever.
Vesade shennechrash bah kever, bet happeras kare leh? in, vehatnan: shelosha bet happeras hen: sade shenneevad bah kever, vesade shennechrash bah kever, usede vochin.
May "sede vochin"? rav yehoshua bar abba mishshemeh deulla amar: sade shemmaftirin bah metim.
Vetama may, amar avimi: mishshum yeush bealim nagu bah.
Usede shennechrash bah kever la bae tziyyun? veha tanya: matza sade metzuyyenet veen yadua ma tivah, yesh bah ilanot — beyadua shennechrash bah kever. en bah ilanot — beyadua sheavad bah kever.
Rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyehe sham zaken o talmid, lefi sheen hakkol bekiin baddavar!
Amar rav pappa: ki tanya hahi, besade sheavad bah kever detzayyeynuha. yesh bah ilanot — beyadua shennechrash bah kever, en bah ilanot — beyadua sheavad bah kever.
Velechush dilma ilanot miggavvay vekever mibbaray?
Kidamar ulla: beomdin al haggevulin, hacha name: beomdin al haggevulin.

a: Vedilma tumea miggavvay veilanot mibbaray?
Bimsubbachin. veibbaet ema, ha amaran: en marchikin tziyyun mimmekom tumea shello lehafesid et eretz yisrael.
Rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyehe sham zaken o talmid, lefi sheen hakkol bekiin baddavar. amar abbaye: shema minna tzureba merabbanan deikka bemata — kol mille demata aleh ramya.
Amar rav yehuda: matza even metzuyyenet — tachteha tame. shetayim, im yesh sid benehen — benehen tame, veim en sid benehen — benehen tahor.
Veaf al gav delekka choresh? vehatanya: matza even achat metzuyyenet — tachteha tame. shetayim, im yesh choresh benehen — benehen tahor, veim lav — benehen tame!
Amar rav pappa: hacha keshehassid shafuch al rashehen umerudde lechan ulechan. i ikka choresh benehen — benehen tahor, deemor mechamat choresh hu deikkefal, vei la, sid devene bene hu vetame.

Amar rabbi assi metzer echad metzuyyan — hu tame, vechol hassade kullah tehora. shenayim — hem temein, vechol hassade kullah tehora. shelosha — hem temein, vechol hassade kullah tehora. arbaa — hen tehorin, vechol hassade kullah temea.
Deamar mar: en marchikin tziyyun mimmekom tumea, shello lehafesid et eretz yisrael.
Veyotzin af al hakkilayim.
Veakkilayim bechullo shel moed nafkinan? ureminhu: beechad baadar mashmiin al hashshekalim veal hakkilayim.

Bachamishsha asar bo korin et hammegilla bakkerakkim, veyotzin lekavvevtz et hadderachim, uletakken harchovot, velamod hammikvaot. veosin kol tzorche rabbim, umetzayyenin et hakkevarot, veyotzin al hakkilayim.
Rabbi elazar verabbi yose bar chanina, chad amar: kan bevakkir, kan beafil. vechad amar: kan bizraim, kan birakot.
Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella sheen nitztzan nikkar, aval nitztzan nikkar — yotzin alehen.
May shena bechullo shel moed denafkinan? amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: mishshum sechar peula demozli gabban.

Amar rav zevid veittema rav mesharsheya: shema minna, ki yahavinan lehu sachar — mitterumat hallishka yahavinan lehu. dei salka datach middidhu yahavinan lehu — may nafka lan minnayyhu? kol kamma devau litten lehu!
Vead kamma? amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak, keotah sheshshaninu: kol sea sheyyesh bah
b: Rova zera mimmin acher — yemaet.
Vehatanya: hitkinu sheyyehu mafkirin kol hassade kullah! la kashya: kan kodem takkana, kan leachar takkana.
Detanya: barishona hayu okrin umashlichin lifne behemtan, vehayu baale battim semechin shete semachot: achat shemmenakkeshin lahem sedotehen, veachat shemmashlichin lifne behemtam,
Hitkinu sheyyehu okrin umashlichin al hadderachim. vaadayin hayu semechin simcha gedola shemmenakkeshin sedotehen, hitkinu sheyyehu mafkirin kol hassade kullah.

Mishna rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: moshchin et hammayim meilan leilan, uvilvad shello yashke et kol hassade. zeraim shello shatu lifne hammoed — la yashkem bammoed. vachachamim mattirin baze uvaze.

Gemara amar rav yehuda: im hayta sade metunnenet — muttar. tanya name hachi: kesheamru asur lehashekotan bammoed, lo amru ella bizraim shello shatu millifne hammoed, aval zeraim sheshshatu lifne hammoed — muttar lehashekotan bammoed.
Veim hayta sade metunnenet — muttar. veen mashkin sede garid bammoed, vachachamim mattirin baze uvaze.
Amar ravina: shema minna hay tarbitza shere letarbotze bechulla demoada. sede garid may tama — deafla meshavve la charfa, hacha name — afla meshavve lah charfa.
Tanu rabbanan: marbitzin sede lavan bashsheviit, aval lo bammoed.
Veha tanya: marbitzin ben bammoed ben bashsheviit! amar rav huna, la kashya: ha rabbi eliezer ben yaakov, ha rabbanan.
Tanya iddach: marbitzin sede lavan erev sheviit kede sheyyetzu yerakot bashsheviit, velo od ella shemmarbitzin sede lavan bashsheviit kede sheyyetzu yerakot lemotzae sheviit.
Mishna tzadin et haishut veet haachbarim missede hailan umissede hallavan kedarko bammoed uvishviit. vachachamim omrim: missede hailan — kedarko, umissede hallavan — shello kedarko.
Umekarin et happirtza bammoed, uvashsheviit bone kedarko.
Gemara may ishut? amar rav yehuda: beriyya sheen lah enayim. amar rava bar yishmael veittema rav yemar bar shelemya: may kera? "kemo shabbelul temes yahaloch nefel eshet bal chazu shamesh".

Tanu rabbanan: tzadin et haishut veet haachbarim missede hallavan umissede hailan kedarko, umachrivin chore nemalim. ketzad machrivin? rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: mevi afar mechor ze venoten letoch chor ze, vehen chonkin ze et ze.
Amar rav yemar bar shelemya mishshemeh deabbaye: vehu dekae bitre evre nahara, vehu delekka gishra, vehu delekka gamla, vehu delekka mitzra.

a: Ad kamma — ad parsa.

Rabbi yehuda omer: missede hailan kedarko, umissede hallavan shello kedarko. tanu rabbanan: ketzad kedarko? chofer gumma vetole bah metzuda. ketzad shello kedarko? noetz shappud umakke bekuredom umeradde haadama mittachteha.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: kesheamru missede lavan shello kedarko, lo amru ella bisde lavan hassemucha lair, aval bisde lavan hassemucha lisde hailan — afillu kedarko, shemma yetzu missede hallavan veyachrivu et hailanot.
Umekarin et happirtza bammoed. ketzad mekarin? rav yosef amar: behutza vedafna.
Bematnita tana: tzar bitzror, veeno tach betit. amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella kotel haggina, aval kotel hechatzer — bone kedarko.
Lema mesayyay leh: kotel haggoche lirshut harabbim — soter uvone kedarko mippene hassakkana. hatam kidkatane tama — mippene hassakkana.
Veikka deamri, ta shema: kotel haggoche lirshut harabbim — soter uvone kedarko mippene hassakkana. mippene hassakkana — in, shello mippene hassakkana — la. lema tehve teyuveteh derav chisda?
Amar lecha rav chisda: hatam soter uvone, hacha bone velo soter.
Hatam name, listor vela livne! im ken, mimmena vela sotar.
Amar rav ashe: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: uvashsheviit bone kedarko.
Dehecha? illema dechatzer, tzericha lememar? ella lav, deginna. veaf al gav demichaze keman deaved netiruta lefere. shema minna.
Mishna rabbi meir omer: roin et hannegaim battechilla lehakel, aval lo lehachemir. vachachamim omrim: lo lehakel velo lehachemir.
Gemara tanya, rabbi meir omer: roin et hannegaim lehakel, aval lo lehachemir. rabbi yose omer: lo lehakel velo lehachemir. sheim atta nizkak lo lehakel — [atta] nizkak lo af lehachemir.
Amar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi meir bemusegar, vedivre rabbi yose bemuchelat.
Amar rava: betahor kulle alma la peligi dela chazu leh. behesger rishon dechulle alma la peligi dechaze leh. ki peligi,
b: Behesger sheni. mar savar: bechohen talya milleta. i tahor — amar leh "tahor", vei tame — shatek. umar savar: "letaharo o letammeo" ketiv.
Amar mar, amar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi yose bemuchelat, vedivre rabbi meir bemusegar. vehatanya ippecha!
Tannae hi allibba derabbi. mar savar: tzavvta dealma adif leh.
Umar savar: tzavvta deishto adifa leh.

Lememra demuchelat muttar betashmish hammitta? in, vehatanya: "veyashav michutz leoholo shivat yamim", sheyyehe asur betashmish hammitta. veen "oholo" ella ishto, shenneemar: "lech emor lahem shuvu lachem leoholechem". rabbi yehuda omer: "shivat yamim yisperu lo", yeme sefiro velo yeme chilluto.
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: shiva yeme sefiro, kal vachomer lime chilluto.
Veamar rabbi chiyyay, danti lifne rabbi: limmadtanu rabbenu, yotam lo haya lo leuzziyyahu ella bime chilluto, amar lo: af ani kach amarti.
Bemay kamippalgi? rabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar: galli rachamana bime sefiro vechol shekken bime chilluto. umar savar: may degalli — galli, umay dela galli — la galli.
Lememra divchohen talya milleta? in, vehatanya: "uveyom heraot bo". yesh yom sheatta roe bo, veyesh yom shei atta roe bo.
Mikkan amru: chatan shennolad bo nega — notnin lo shiva yeme hammishte. lo uleveto velichsuto. vechen baregel — notnin lo shivat yeme haregel, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi omer: eno tzarich. hare hu omer: "vetzivva hakkohen ufinnu et habbayit". im mamtinim lo lidvar harshut — kol shekken lidvar mitzva.
May benayyhu? amar abbaye: mashmaut dorshin ikka benayyhu. verava amar: devar harshut ikka benayyhu.
Verabbi yehuda — mehatam la gamrinan, dechiddush hu,

a: Deha etzim vaavanim bealma la mittammeu, vehacha mittammeu.
Verabbi amar: itzterich, dei ketav rachamana "uveyom heraot bo", have amena lidvar mitzva — in, lidvar harshut — la, ketav rachamana "vetzivva hakkohen".
Vei ketav rachamana "vetzivva hakkohen", hava amena: hane — in, delav tumea degufeh, aval tumea degufeh — ema michza chazya leh. tzericha.
Amar mar: yesh yom sheatta roe bo, veyesh yom shei atta roe bo.
May mashma? amar abbaye: im ken lichtov rachamana "beyom", may "uveyom"? shema minna: yesh yom sheatta roe bo, veyesh yom shei atta roe bo.
Rava amar: kullah kera yattira hu, deim ken lichtov rachamana "uveheraot", may "uveyom"? shema minna: yesh yom sheatta roe bo, veyesh yom shei atta roe bo.
Veabbaye, hahu mibbee leh — bayyom velo ballayla.
Verava, bayyom velo ballayla mena leh? nafka leh millechol mare ene hakkohen". veabbaye, hahu mibbee leh lemaote some beachat meenav.
Verava name mibbee leh lehachi? in, hachi name.
Veella bayyom velo ballayla mena leh? nafka leh mikkenega nira li babbayit". "li" — velo leori.
Veabbaye, i mehatam hava amena: hane mille tumea delav degufeh, aval tumea degufeh afillu leoro name, ka mashma lan.
Mishna veod amar rabbi meir: melakket adam atzmot aviv veimmo, mippene shessimcha hi lo.
Rabbi yose omer: evel hu lo.
Lo yeorer adam al meto, velo yaspidennu kodem laregel sheloshim yom.
Gemara ureminhu: hamelakket atzmot aviv veimmo — hare ze mitabbel alehem kol hayyom, velaerev en mitabbel alehen. veamar rav chisda: afillu tzerurin lo bisdino!
Amar abbaye: ema, mippene shessimchat haregel alav.
Velo yearer al meto. may lo yearer al meto? amar rav: kad hadar safdana bemareva, amri: yivkon immeh kol merire libba.
Kodem haregel sheloshim yom. may shena sheloshim yom?

Amar rav kahana amar rav yehuda amar rav: maase beadam echad shekkinnes maot laalot laregel, uva safdan veamad al petach beto, unetalatan ishto unetanatan lo, venimna velo ala. beotah shaa amru: lo yeorer al meto velo yaspidennu kodem laregel sheloshim yom.
Ushemuel amar:
b: Lefi sheen hammet mishtakkeach min hallev sheloshim yom. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu dekaaved bechinnam.
Mishna en chofrin kuchin ukevarot bammoed, aval mechannechin et hakkuchin bammoed. veosin nivrechet bammoed, vearon im hammet bechatzer. rabbi yehuda oser ella im ken yesh immo nesarim.
Gemara may kuchin umay kevarot? amar rav yehuda: kuchin bachafira, ukevarot bevinyan. tanya name hachi: ellu hen kuchin veellu hen kevarot, kuchin bachafira, ukevarot bevinyan.
Aval mechannechin et hakkuchin. ketzad mechannechin? amar rav yehuda: sheim haya aroch — mekatztzero. bematnita tana: maarich bo, umarchiv bo.
Veosin nivrechet kulei. may nivrechet? amar rav yehuda: zo bakia. vehatanya: hannivrechet vehabbakia! amar abbaye veittema rav kahana: giha uvar giha.

Vearon im hammet bechatzer. tenena leha detanu rabbanan: osin kol tzorche hammet. gozzin lo searo, umechabbesin lo kesuto, veosin lo aron minnesarin hamenussarin meerev yom tov. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af meviin etzim umenasseran betzina betoch beto.
Mishna en nosin nashim bammoed, lo betulot velo almanot, velo meyaybmin — mippene shessimcha hi lo. aval machzir hu et gerushato.
Veosa ishsha tachshiteha bammoed. rabbi yehuda omer: lo tasud, mippene shenniuul hu lah. hahedyot tofer kedarko, vehaumman machliv. umesargin et hammittot, rabbi yose omer: memattechin.

Gemara vechi simcha hi lo, may have? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel, vechen amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya, veamri la: amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: lefi sheen mearvin simcha besimcha. rabba bar [rav] huna amar: mippene shemmanniach simchat haregel veosek besimchat ishto.

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: ha derabba bar [rav] huna — derav hu. deamar rav daniel bar kattina amar rav: minnayin sheen nosin nashim bammoed, shenneemar: "vesamachta bechaggecha", "bechaggecha" — velo beishtecha.
Ulla amar: mippene hattorach. rabbi yitzchak nappacha amar: mippene bittul periyya ureviyya.
Metivi: kol ellu sheamru asurin lissa bammoed —

a: Muttarin lissa erev haregel, kashya lechullehu.
La kashya leman deamar mishshum simcha — ikkar simcha chad yoma hu.
Leman deamar mishshum tircha — ikkar tircha chad yoma hu. leman deamar mishshum bittul periyya ureviyya, lechad yoma la mashhe inish nafsheh.

Udeen mearvin simcha besimcha menalan? dichtiv: "vayyaas shelomo vaet hahi et hechag vechol yisrael immo kahal gadol millevo chamat ad nachal mitzrayim [lifne Adonai elohenu] shivat yamim veshivat yamim arbaa asar yom". veim ita dimarvin simcha besimcha — ibbei leh lemintar ad hechag, umibad shiva lehacha ulehacha.
Vedilma mintar la natrinan, vehecha deitremi — avdinan! ibbei leh leshayyore pureta.
Shayyore binyan bet hammikdash la meshayyeyrinan. ibbei leh leshayyore beamma kalya orev.
Amma kalya orev tzorech binyan habbayit hu. ella middimyaytar kera, mikkede ketiv "arbea asar yom", "shivat yamim veshivat yamim" lema li? shema minna hane lechod vehane lechod.

Amar rabbi parnach amar rabbi yochanan: otah shana lo asu yisrael et yom hakkippurim. vehayu doagim veomrim: shemma nitchayyeyvu sonehen shel yisrael kelayay, yatzta bat kol veamra lahem: kullechem mezummanin lechayye haolam habba.

May derush? amru, kal vachomer: uma mishkan, sheen kedushshato kedushshat olam — vekorban yachid doche shabbat deissur sekila, mikdash, dikdushshato kedushshat olam, vekorban tzibbur, veyom hakkippurim deanush karet — lo kol shekken?!
Ella, ammay hayu doagim? hatam tzorech gavoah, hacha tzorech hedyot. hacha name: mebad libedu, mechol la nechlu vela lishto! en simcha belo achila ushetiyya.

Umishkan dedache shabbat menalan? illema middichtiv: "bayyom harishon, uvayyom hashshevii", dilma shevii lekorbanot! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, amar kera: "beyom ashte asar yom". ma yom kullo ratzuf, af ashte asar kullan retzufin.
Vedilma yamim haruyin? ketiv kera acharina: "beyom shenem asar yom". ma yom kullo ratzuf, af shenem asar yom kullan retzufin.
Vedilma hacha name yamim haruyin! im ken, tere kerae lema li?
Umikdash dedoche yom hakkippurim, menalan? illema middichtiv: "arbaa asar yom", vedilma yamim haruyin! gamar "yom" "yom" mehatam.

Yatzta bat kol veamra lahem: kullechem mezummanin lechayye haolam habba. umenalan deachel lehu? detane tachlifa: "bayyom hashshemini shillach et haam vayvarchu et hammelech vayyelchu leoholehem semechim vetove lev al kol hattova asher asa Adonai ledavid avdo uleyisrael ammo".

"Leoholehem" — shehalchu umatzu nashehem betohora, "semechim" — shennehenu mizziv hashshechina, "vetove lev" — shekkol echad veechad nitabbera ishto beven zachar, "al kol hattova" — sheyyatzta bat kol veamra lahem: kullechem mezummanin lechayye haolam habba.
"Ledavid avdo uleyisrael ammo". bishlama "leyisrael ammo" — deachel lehu avon yom hakkippurim, ella "ledavid avdo" may hi?

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: beshaa shebbikkesh shelomo lehachenis aron lammikdash davku shearim ze laze. amar shelomo esrim vearba renanot velo naana, patach veamar "seu shearim rashechem vegomer" velo naana,

Kevan sheamar "Adonai elohim al tashev pene meshichecha zochra lechasde david avdecha" — miyyad naana. beotah shaa nehpechu pene sone david keshule kedera, veyadu hakkol shemmachal lo hakkadosh baruch hu al oto avon.

Rabbi yonatan ben asmayy verabbi yehuda ben gerim tanu parashat nedarim be rabbi shimon ben yochay, ippetur minneh beureta. letzafra hadur veka mippatri minneh. amar lehu: velav ippatritu minnay beureta?

Amaru leh: limmadtanu rabbenu talmid shenniftar merabbo velan beotah hair, tzarich lippater mimmennu paam acheret, shenneemar: "bayyom hashshemini shillach et haam vayvarachu et hammelech", uchetiv: "uveyom esrim ushelosha lachodesh hashshevii shillach et haam"!
Ella, mikkan letalmid hanniftar merabbo velan beotah hair, tzarich lippater mimmennu paam acheret.

Amar leh livreh: bene adam hallalu anashim shel tzura hem, zil gabbehon delivarchuch. azal, ashkechinhu deka ramu kerae ahadade. ketiv: "palles magal raglecha vechol derachecha yikkonu", uchetiv: "orach chayyim pen tefalles".
La kashya: kan bemitzva sheefshar laasotah al yede acherim,
b: Kan bemitzva shei efshar laasotah al yede acherim.

Hadar yatvi veka mibbee lehu, ketiv: "yekara hi mippeninim vechol chafatzecha lo yishvu vah" — ha cheftze shamayim yishvu vah, uchetiv: "kol chafatzim lo yishvu vah" — daafillu cheftze shamayim lo yishvu vah!
Kan bemitzva sheefshar laasotah al yede acherim, kan bemitzva shei efshar laasotah al yede acherim.

Amaru leh: may baet hacha? amar lehu, daamar li abba: zil gabbayyhu delivarchuch. amaru leh: yehe raava detizra vela techtzad, teayyel vela taypevk, taypevk vela teayyel, lichrov betach velittov ushepizach, libbalbal paturach, vela tichze shatta chadta.

Ki ata legabbe avu, amar leh: la mibbaya devaroche la bayrchun aval tzaore tzaavrun. amar leh: may amaru lach? hachi vehachi amaru li. amar leh: hanach kullehu birchata ninhu. tizra vela techtzad: tolid banim vela yemutu. teayyel vela taypevk: teayyel kalleta vela lemutu benach delippekun. taypevk vela teayyel: tolid benata vela yemutu guverayyhu velihderu levataych.
Lichrov betach velittov ushepizach — dehay alma ushepizach, vehahuy alma beta, dichtiv: "kirbam battemo leolam". al tikre "kirbam", ella "kivram".
Libbalbal paturach: bivne uvenata. vela tichze shatta chadta: dela temut ittetach vela tinsav inteta achariti.

Rabbi shimon ben chalafta ippetar minneh derav, amar leh avu: zil legabbeh delivarchach. amar leh: yehe raava dela tevayyesh vela titbayyaysh. ata gabbe avu. amar leh: may amar lach? amar leh: millin bealma hu deamar li.

Amar leh: barchach birketa deverchan kudesha berich hu leyisrael utena ba, dichtiv: "vaachaltem achol vesavoa vehillaltem vegomer velo yevoshu ammi leolam. vidatem ki vekerev yisrael ani vegomer velo yevoshu ammi leolam".
Veosa ishsha tachshiteha. tanu rabbanan, ellu hen tachshite nashim: kochelet ufokeset umaavira serak al paneha. veikka deamri maaveret serak al paneha shel matta.
Devethu derav chisda mikkashsheta beanpe kalleta. yatev rav huna bar chinnana kammeh derav chisda veyatev vekaamar: lo shanu ella yalda, aval zekena — lo.
Amar leh: haelohim! afillu immacha vaafillu imma deimmach, vaafillu omedet al kivrah. deamri inashe: bat shittin kevat shet, lekal tavla rahata.

Rabbi yehuda omer: lo tasud. tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: ishsha lo tasud mippene shenniuul hu lah. umode rabbi yehuda besid sheyyechola lekappelo bammoed, shettofalto bammoed. sheaf al pi shemmetzera hi achshav — semecha hi leachar zeman.
Umi it leh lerabbi yehuda hay sevara? vehatnan:
Rabbi yehuda omer: nifrain mehen mippene shemmetzer. amru lo: af al pi shemmetzer achshav — sameach hu leachar zeman!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: hannach lehilchot moed, dechullehu metzer achshav vesameach leachar zeman ninhu.
Ravina amar: goy leinyan peraon leolam metzer.

Amar rav yehuda: benot yisrael shehiggiu lefirkan velo higgiu leshanim, aniyyot toflot otan besid, ashirot toflot otan besolet, benot melachim beshemen hammor, shenneemar: "shishsha chodashim beshemen hammor".
May "shemen hammor"? rav huna bar chiyyay amar: setachat, rav yirmeya bar amme amar: shemen zayit shello hevi shelish.
Tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: anpikinun — shemen zayit shello hevi shelish. velamma sachin oto? shemmashshir et hassear umeadden et habbasar.

Rav bivi hava leh beratta, tafla ever ever. shekal ba arba mea zuze. hava hahu goy beshivavuteh dahava leh beratta. tafla bechad zimna umita, amar: katla bivi livratti. amar rav nachman: rav bivi deshate shichra — baayayn benateh tifla, anan dela shatenan shichra — la baayayn benatin tifla.

a: Hahedyot tofer kedarko. hechi dame hedyot? amri deve rabbi yannay: kol sheeno yachol lehotzi melo machat bevat achat. rabbi yose bar chanina amar: kol sheeno yachol lechavven imra bechefet chaluko.
Vehaumman machliv. may machliv? rabbi yochanan amar: mafsia. rabba bar shemuel amar: shinne chalbeta.

Mesargin et hammittot. may "mesargin" umay "memattechin"? ki ata rav dimi amar: peligi ba rabbi chiyyay bar abba verabbi assi, vetarvayyhu mishshemeh dechizkiyya verabbi yochanan chad amar: mesargin — sheti vaerev, umemattechin — sheti belo erev. vechad amar: mesargin — sheti belo erev, umemattechin — sheim haya rafuy, memattecho.

Ini? veha tane rav tachlifa bar shaul: veshavin sheen mafshilin chavalim lechattechilla. bishlama leman deamar mesargin — sheti vaerev, umemattechin — sheti belo erev, hayeynu dekatane rav tachlifa bar shaul: veshavin sheen mafshilin chavalim lechattechilla.
Ella leman deamar mesargin — sheti belo erev, memattechin — sheim haya rafuy haya memattecho. hasheta sheti vaerev amrat la — chavalim lechattechilla mibbaya?! kashya.
Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerabbi chiyyay bar avin: mi ikka leman deamar mesargin — sheti belo erev? vehatnan, rabbi meir omer: hammitta mishsheyyesareg bah shelosha battim!
Ella, ki ata ravin amar: bimsargin kulle alma la peligi dishti vaerev, ella ki peligi bimmattechin. mar savar memattechin — sheti belo erev, umar savar: sheim haya rafuy memattecho.
Metivi: mesargin et hammitta, veen tzarich lomar shemmemattechin, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: memattechin, aval lo mesargin. veyesh omrim: en memattechin kol ikkar.
Bishlama leman deamar memattechin sheti belo erev, hayeynu deatu yesh omrim leippeloge. ella leman deamar sheim haya rafuy memattecho, leyesh omrim memattecho name la?
In, kevan deefshar lemimleyeh bemane — la tarchinan.
Mishna maamidin tannur vechirayim verechayim bammoed. rabbi yehuda omer: en mechabbeshin et harechayim battechilla.
Gemara may mechabbeshin? rav yehuda amar: menakkar richya. rav yechiel amar: bat ena.

Metivi: maamidin tannur vechirayim bammoed, uvilvad shello yigmor melachtan, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim: af yigmor. rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo: maamidin et hachadasha, umechabbeshin et hayyeshana. veyesh omrim: en mechabbeshin kol ikkar.
Bishlama leman deamar mechabbeshin menakkar richya — hayeynu demashkachat la bishana, ella leman deamar bat ena yeshana — bat ena lema la? kegon deka bae learvoche tefe pureta.
Rav huna shameh lehahu gavra deka menakkar richya bechulla demoada, amar: man hay? ittachil gufeh deka machel chulla demoada. savar la keyesh omrim.
Daresh rav chama: nokrin rechayim bammoed. mishshum rabbi meir amar: afillu sus sherochev alav vachamor sherochev alav — muttar littol tzippornayim bechullo shel moed,
b: Aval chamara derichya — la.
Rav yehuda shere lemishkal tufereh lachamara derichya, uleokome richya, ulemivne richya, ulemivne ammat richya, ulemivne ureya. rava shera lesaroke suseya, ulemivne akrafita, ulemivne itzteva.
Rava shera lemishkal dema livhema bechulla demoada. amar leh abbaye, tanya dimsayyay lach: makkizin dam labbehema, veen monin refua labbehema bechullo shel moed.
Rava shera lechaskose kirme. may tama — maase hedyot hu. amar rav yitzchak bar amme amar rav chisda: kitture vere — asir. may tama — maase umman hu.
Amar rava: man dimtakkel ara addata deve dare — shere, addata deara — asir.
Hechi dame? — muleya bemuleya venatztza benatztza — addata deve dare, shekal muleya usheda benatztza — addata deara.
Veamar rava: hay man dezache ziche, addata detzive — shere, addata deara — asir. hechi dame? shakel ravreve veshavek zutere — addata detzive, shekal ravreve vezutere — addata deara.
Veamar rava: hay man defatach mayya leareh, addata dichvore — shere, addata deara — asir.
Hechi dame? patach tere vave, chad meillay vechad mittattay — addata dichvore, petach chad bava — addata deara.
Veamar rava: hay man defashach dikla, addata dechevata — shere, addata dedikla — asir. hechi dame? shakel kulleh mechad gisa — addata dechevata, mehay gisa umehay gisa — addata dedikla vaasir.
Veamar rava: hane tamre tuchelani, migzerinhu — shere, mayytzinhu — asir. rav pappa amar: kevan dematlei — kifrakmatya haaved dame, veshare.

Veamar rava: perakmatya kol shehu, asur. amar rabbi yose bar avin: uvaddavar haaved — muttar. ravina hava leh hahu iska dahava mizdabban beshitta alfe, shahayeh lezabboneh batar chulla demoada vezabbeneh bitresar alfe.

Ravina hava massek zuze bivne akra deshanvata, ata lekammeh derav ashe, amar leh: mahu lemezal haiddana alayyhu? amar leh: kevan dehaiddana hu demashkachat lehu, beyome acharine la mashkachat lehu — kifrakmatya haaved dame, veshare.
Tanya name gabbe avoda zara ki hay gavvna: holchin

a: Leyarid shel goyim, velokchim behema, avadim ushefachot, battim, sadot ucheramim, vechotev umaale baarkaot shellahen, mippene shehu kematztzil miyyadan.
Rav shera lechiyyay bar ashe lemigdal uhari bechulla demoada. may tama — maase hedyot hu, aval izle — asur. may tama — maase umman hu.

Rav yehuda shera leamme tannuraa lemigdal tannure, ulerabba bar isbi lemigdal maholata. ini? veha tane rabba bar shemuel: veshavin sheen godlin tannur lechattechilla! la kashya: kan bimot hachamma, kan bimot haggeshamim.
Mishna osin maake laggag velammirpeset maase hedyot, aval lo maase umman. shafin et hassedakin umaagilin otan bammaagila, bayyad uvaregel aval lo bemachlatzayim.
Hatztzir vehatztzinnor vehakkora vehammanul vehammafteach shennishberu — metakkenan bammoed, uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot melachto bammoed.
Vechol kevashin shehu yachol leechol mehen bammoed kovshan.
Gemara hechi dame maase hedyot? rav yosef amar: behutza vedafna. bematnita tana: tzar bitzror veeno tach betit.

Shafin et hassedakin umaagilin otan bammaagila. hasheta bemaagila amrat shere — bayyad uvaregel mibbaya? hachi kaamar: shafin et hassedakin umaagilin otan keen maagila, bayyad uvaregel, aval lo bemachlatzayim.
Hatztzir vehatztzinnor vehakkora vehammanul vehammafteach shennishberu — metakkenan bammoed. ureminhi: ad yamav haya pattish makke birushalayim kulei. ad yamav — in, mikkan veelach — la!
La kashya: kan bidnappache, kan bidnaggare.
Matkef la rav chisda: yomru, kala rabba — asir, kala zutera — shere! ella amar rav chisda, la kashya: ha — bemaggale, ha — bachatzine. rav pappa amar: kan — kodem gezera, kan — leachar gezera.
Rav ashe amar: ha — rabbi yehuda, ha — rabbi yose. deamar rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi: man tanna shinnuy bammoed bedavar haaved — dela kerabbi yose.
Amar ravina: keman medallinan haiddana kibbeyvata dedashsha bechulla demoada, keman — kerabbi yose.
Kevashin shehu yachol leechol bammoed — kovshan. bedita levay kevore, azul kulle alma tzud ayyto kevore, shera lehu rava lemimlach minnayyhu.
Amar leh abbaye, veha tenan: kevashin shehu yachol leechol mehen bammoed — kovshan! amar leh: kevan demeikkara addata daachila ayytinhu, vei shavek lehu pasdi, kifrakmatya haaved dame, ushere.
Veikka deamri, shera lehu rava metzad mezal ayytoye umimlach. amar leh abbaye: veha anan, kevashin shehu yachol leechol mehen kovshan tenan!
Amar leh: hane name mitachli aggav itzatza. ki ha dishmuel avadu leh shittin itzatze vaachal. rava ikkela leve resh galuta, avdi leh shittin itzatze vaachal.
Rav ikkela leve rav shappir, ayyto lekammayyhu hahu kevora tilta bishshula tilta milcha vetilta tavvya.
Amar rav: amar li adda tzayyayda, kevora samuch lemisrecheh mealle. veamar rav, amar li adda tzayyayda: kevora, tavvyay baachu, assokeh baavu, mechle[] bivreh, mishte aleh avu.
Veamar rav, amar li adda tzayyayda: kevora, tachle, vachalava — liton gufa vela liton pureya. veamar rav, amar li adda tzayyayda: kevora, tachle, vachalava — mayya vela shichra, shichra vela chamra.
Hadaran alach mashkin bet hashshelachin
b: Mi shehafach et zetav veero evel o ones, o shehituhu poalim — toen kora rishona umannichah leachar hammoed, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi yose omer: zolef vegomer, vegaf kedarko.
Gemara patach beevel vesiyyem bammoed. amar rav shisha bereh derav idi zot omeret: devarim hammuttarin bammoed, asurim bime evlo.
Rav ashe amar, la mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya bime evlo, demidderabbanan hu ushere, ella afillu bammoed, deissur melacha middeorayyta bimkom peseda — sharu rabbanan.

Tanya kevoteh derav shisha bereh derav idi. ellu devarim haosin laavel bime evlo: zetav hafuchin — toanin lo, vechaddo laguf ufishtano lehaalot min hammishra, vetzamro lehaalot min hayyora, umarbitzim sadehu mishshettaggia onat hammayim shello.
Rabbi yehuda omer: af zorin lo sede nir vesade haomedet lefishtan. amru lo: im lo tizzara bevakkir — tizzara beafil, im lo tizzara pishtan — tizzara mimmin acher.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: zetav hafuchin veen sham umman ella hu, kaddo laguf veen sham umman ella hu, pishtano lehaalot min hammishra vetzamro lehaalot min hayyora veen sham umman ella hu — hare ze yaase betzina.
Yater al ken amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: im haya umman larabbim, vesappar uvallan larabbim, vehiggia et haregel veen sham umman ella hu — hare ze yaase.

Haarisin vehachachirin vehakkabbelanin — hare ellu yaasu acherim bishvilan. hachammarin haggammalin vehassappanin — hare ellu lo yaasu, veim hayu muchekarin o musekarin etzel acherim — hare ellu yaasu. sechir yom afillu beir acheret — lo yaase. hayta melechet acherim beyado, af al pi shebbekibbolet — lo yaase.
Af al pi shebbekibbolet, vela mibbaya sheenah kibbolet?! adderabba, kibbolet kedideh dame! ella ema: ben kibbolet ben sheenah kibbolet — lo yaase.
Hayta melachto beyad acherim, beveto — lo yaasu, bevayit acher — yaasu.

Mariyyon bereh deravin umar bereh derav acha bereh derava hava lehu hahu gamla detora bahade hadade. itteraa beh milleta bemar bereh derav acha bereh derava ufaskeh legamleh. amar rav ashe: gavra rabba kemar bereh derav acha aved hachi? nehi delifseda dideh la chayesh, addaacherim la chayesh?! veha tanya: im hayu musekarin o muchekarin etzel acherim — hare ellu yaasu!
Vehu savar: adam chashuv shane.

a: Amar shemuel: mekabbele kibbolet, betoch hattechum — asur. chutz lattechum — muttar.
Amar rav pappa: vaafillu chutz lattechum, lo amaran ella delekka mata dimkarva lehatam, aval ikka mata dimkarva lehatam — asur.

Amar rav mesharsheya: vechi lekka mata dimkarva lehatam name, la amaran ella beshabbatot uveyamim tovim, dela shechichi inashe deazli lehatam, aval bechullo shel moed, dishchichi inashe deazli veatu lehatam — asur.
Mar zutera bereh derav nachman benu leh appadna mekabbele kibbolet chutz lattechum. ikkela rav safra verav huna bar chinnana, vela allu legabbeh. veikka deamri: hu name la al begavvevy.
Vehaamar shemuel: mekabbele kibbolet — betoch hattechum asur, chutz lattechum muttar! adam chashuv shane. veikka deamri: sayyoe sayyay betivna bahadayyhu.
Rav chama shera lehu leavvangare deve resh galuta lemebad lehu avidta bechulla demoada, amar: kevan daagar la ka shakli, sharshoye hu deka mesharshu leh, velet lan ba.

Tanu rabbanan: mekabbelin kibbolet bammoed laasotah leachar hammoed, uvammoed asur. kelalo shel davar: kol shehu ose — omer legoy veose, vechol sheeno ose — eno omer legoy veose. tanya iddach: mekabbelin kibbolet bammoed laasotah leachar hammoed, uvilvad shello yimdod veshello yishkol veshello yimne kederech shehu ose bachol.
Tanu rabbanan: en marbiin behema bechullo shel moed. kayyotze bo: en marbiin bivchor velo bifsule hammukedashin.
Tanya iddach: en marbiin behema bechullo shel moed, rabbi yehuda omer: chamora shettava — marbiin aleha zachar bishvil shello titztannen, ushear kol habbehemot — machnisin otan levakrut.
Tanu rabbanan: en medayyeyrin lo beshabbatot velo beyamim tovim velo bechullo shel moed. veim bau mealehen — muttar.

Veen mesayyeyin otan, veen mosrin lahem shomer lenaer et tzonam. haya sechir shabbat, sechir chodesh, sechir shana, sechir shavua — mesayyeyin otan, umosrin lahem shomer lenaer et tzonam. rabbi omer: bashshabbat — betova, beyom tov — bimzonot, bammoed — besachar. amar rav yosef: hilcheta kerabbi.
Mishna vechen mi shehaya yeno betoch habbor veero evel o ones o shehituhu — zolef vegomer vegaf kedarko, divre rabbi yose. rabbi yehuda omer: ose lo limmudim bishvil shello yachmitz.

Gemara utzericha. dei ashmeinan kammayyta, behahi kaamar rabbi yose — mishshum demishcha nefish pesedeh, aval chamra dela nefish pesedeh — ema mode leh lerabbi yehuda. vei ashmeinan batrayyta, behahi kaamar rabbi yehuda, aval behach ema mode lerabbi yose. tzericha.
Amar rav yitzchak bar abba: man tanna shinnuy bammoed bedavar haaved — dela kerabbi yose. amar rav yosef: halacha kerabbi yose.
Beo minneh merav nachman bar yitzchak: mahu lemesha chavita deshichra bechulla demoada? amar lehu: sinay amar halacha kerabbi yose. emor deamar rabbi yose bechamra, beshichra mi amar!
Chamra tama may — mishshum dinfish pesedeh, shichra name it be peseda. deamar abbaye, amara li em: bar shet save usheyia, mibbar tamne vela sheyia.
Amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: hilchot moed kehilchot kutim bahalacha. lemay hilcheta? amar rav daniel bar kattina amar rav: lomar shehen akurot veen lemedot zo mizzo.
Deamar shemuel: zoftin kuzeta veen zoftin chavita. rav dimi minnehardea amar: zoftin chavita veen zoftin kuzeta. mar chayesh lifseda, umar chayesh letircha.
Amar abbaye: naktinan hilchot moed kehilchot shabbat;
b: Yesh mehen patur aval asur, veyesh mehen muttar lechattechilla.

Rav huna chatzadu leh chatzada bemoada. etiveh rabba bar rav huna lerav huna tochanin kemach bammoed letzorech hammoed, veshello letzorech hammoed — asur. davar sheavud bammoed — muttar laasoto bammoed, davar sheeno avud bammoed — asur.
Bamma devarim amurim — bitlushin min hakkarka, aval mechubbar lakkarka — afillu kullo avud asur. veim en lo ma yochal, kotzer umeammer vedash vezore uvorer vetochen, uvilvad shello yadush befarot!

Amar leh: yechidaa hi, vela sevira lan kevoteh. detanya, kelal amar rabban shimon ben gamliel mishshum rabbi yose: davar hattalush min hakkarka, afillu miktzato avud — muttar, vehamechubbar lakkarka — afillu kullo avud asur.
Vei rabbi yose, yadush name befarot?! ha amar rav yitzchak bar abba: man tanna shinnuy bammoed bedavar haaved — dela kerabbi yose!
Amar lach: hacha name, kevan dechol yoma lav befarot dayyshi, haiddana name lav shinnuy hu.

Tanu rabbanan: tochanin bammoed letzorech hammoed, veshello letzorech hammoed — asur. veim tachan vehotir — hare ze muttar. kotztzin etzim bammoed letzorech hammoed, veshello letzorech hammoed — asur, veim katzatz vehotir — hare ze muttar.
Metilin shechar bammoed letzorech hammoed, veshello letzorech hammoed — asur, veim hetil vehotir — hare ze muttar, uvilvad shello yaarim.

Ureminhu: metilin shechar bammoed letzorech hammoed, veshello letzorech hammoed — asur, echad shechar temarim, veechad shechar seorim. veaf al pi sheyyesh lo yashan, maarim veshote min hechadash. tannae hi. detanya: en maarimin bechach, rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: maarimin.
Rav chatzadu leh chatzada bechulla demoada. shema shemuel, ikkefad. lema shemuel kichidaa sevira leh? la, chatzada dechitte hava, dela hava pased.
Verav may tama aved hachi? en lo ma yochal hava. ushemuel — la sayyeymuha kammeh. i name, adam chashuv shane.

Rabbi yehuda nesia nefak bechumarta dimdusha, veishti mayya deachem kappila arammaa. shema rabbi amme, ikkefad. amar rav yosef: may tama ikkefad? i mishshum chumarta dimdusha, ha tanya: hashshirin, hannezamim vehattabbaot — hare hen kechol hakkelim hannittalin bechatzer.
I mishshum deishti mayya deachem kappila arammaa, ha amar shemuel bar yitzchak amar rav: kol shenneechol kemot shehu chay, en bo mishshum bishshule goyim! adam chashuv shane.
Amar rav chananel amar rav: kotzetz adam dekel bammoed, af al pi sheeno tzarich ella lannesoret shello. layet ala abbaye.

Rav ashe hava leh ibba bishlanyay. azal lemiktzeyeh bechulla demoada, amar leh rav shela mishshelanyay lerav ashe: may dataych, dekaamar rav chananel amar rav: kotzetz adam dekel bammoed af al pi sheeno tzarich ella lannesoret shello — ha layet ala abbaye! amar leh: la shemia li, kelomar, la sevira li. ishtemit narga, bae lemifsekeh leshakeh. shavkeh vahadar ata.

Rav yehuda shera lemikar kittana ulemiktal keshuta, ulemikar shumeshme. amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: bishlama kittana — chaze lachafifa, keshuta — chaze leshichra, ella shumeshme lemay chaze? chaze lenazye deit behu.
Rabbi yannay hava leh hahu pardesa dimta zimneh bechulla demoada, katfeh. leshana shahiyyu kulle alma lefardesayyhu lechulla demoada. afkereh rabbi yannay lefardeseh hahiv shatta.
Mishna machnis adam perotav mippene haggannavim, veshole pishtano min hammishra bishvil shello tovad, uvilvad shello yechavven et melachto bammoed. vechullan im kivvevnu melachtan bammoed — yovedu.
Gemara tana: uvilvad sheyyachnisem betzina letoch beto.
Rav yosef hava leh keshure, ayyeylinhu bimama.
Amar leh abbaye, vehatanya: uvilvad sheyyachnisem betzina betoch beto! amar leh: tzina dehane — yemama hu, kevan divlelya bau gavre yattire, uvau madbure denura, avvsha milleta.
Veshole pishtano min hammishra kulei. bae minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: kivvevn melachto bammoed vamet, mahu sheyyiknesu banav acharav?
Im timtze lomar

a: Tzaram ozen bechor kansu beno acharav — mishshum deissura deorayyta,
Veim timtze lomar machar avdo legoy vamet kansu beno acharav — mishshum dechol yoma mafka leh mimmitzvot,
Hacha may: gavra kanes rabbanan — veha leteh, o dilma: mamona kanes rabbanan — veha iteh!

Amar leh, tenetuha: sade shennitkavvevtza bashsheviit — tizzara lemotzae sheviit, nittayyeyva o niddayyeyra — lo tizzara lemotzae sheviit. veamar rabbi yose bar chanina: naktinan, hetivah vamet — beno zorah, alma: ledideh kenasu rabbanan, livreh la kenasu rabbanan. hacha name: ledideh kenasu rabbanan, livreh la kenasu rabbanan.
Amar abbaye: naktinan: timme taharotav vamet — lo kansu beno acharav. may tama — hezzek sheeno nikkar la shemeh hezzek. ledideh kenasu rabbanan, livreh la kenasu rabbanan.
Mishna en lokchin battim avadim uvehema ella letzorech hammoed, o letzorech hammocher sheen lo ma yochal.

Gemara bea minneh rava merav nachman: sechar peulla sheen lo ma yochal, mahu? amar leh, tenena: o letzorech hammocher sheen lo ma yochal. leetoye may? lav leetoye sechar peulla! amar leh: la, paroshe ka mefaresh.
Etiveh abbaye: en kotvin shetare chov bammoed, veim eno maamino, o sheen lo ma yochal — hare ze yichtov. sheen lo ma yochal — leetoye may? lav leetoye sechar peulla! shema minna.

Motev rav sheshet: vachachamim omrim, shalosh ummaniyyot osin melacha bearve fesachim ad chatzot: hachayyaytin vehassapparin vehakkovsin. hachayyaytin — shekken hedyot tofer kedarko bechullo shel moed, hassapparin vehakkovsin — shekken habbain mimmedinat hayyam vehayyotze mibbet haasurin muttarin lesapper ulechabbes bechullo shel moed.
Vei salka datach sechar peulla sheen lo ma yochal shere — kol melachot name lishtero, deha ikka sechar peulla sheen lo ma yochal!
Matkef la rav pappa: ella meatta binyan lishtere, shekken kotel haggohe lirshut harabbim — soter uvone kedarko mippene hassakkana!
Matkef la ravina: ella meatta lavlar lishtere, shekken kotvin kiddushe nashim gittin veshovarin!

Ella amar rav ashe: moed aarbaa asar ka ramet? moed — mishshum tircha hu, uvimkom peseda sharu rabbanan. arbaa asar — mishshum tzorech yom tov hu. midde detzorech yom tov sharu rabbanan, midde delav tzorech yom tov la sharu rabbanan.
Mishna en mefannin mibbayit levayit, aval mefanne hu lachatzero. en meviin kelim mibbet haumman, im choshesh lahem — mefannan lechatzer acheret.
Gemara vehaamrat resha en mefannin kelal? amar abbaye: sefa atan levayit shebbechatzer.
Veen meviin kelim mibbet haumman. amar rav pappa: badek lan rava, tenan: en meviin kelim mibbet haumman, ureminhu: molichin umeviin kelim mibbet haumman, veaf al pi sheenan letzorech hammoed!
Veshannenan leh: kan bearbaa asar, kan bechullo shel moed. ibbaet ema: ha veha bechullo shel moed. kan bemaamino, kan besheeno maamino.
b: Vehatanya: meviin kelim mibbet haumman, kegon kad mibbet hakkaddar, vechos mibbet hazzaggag. aval lo tzemer mibbet hatztzabba, velo kelim mibbet haumman. veim en lo ma yochal — noten lo secharo umannicho etzlo. veim eno maamino — mannicho bevayit hassamuch lo. veim choshesh lahem shemma yigganvu — mefannan lechatzer acheret, veim eno maamino — mevian betzina betoch beto.
Taretzt meviin, molichin kashya, dekatane: en meviin, vechol shekken sheen molichin! ella: mechavvavrta kidshannayin meikkara.

Mishna mechappin et hakketziot bekash. rabbi yehuda omer: af meabbin. mochre ferot, kesut vechelim — mochrim betzina letzorech hammoed. hatztzayyaydin vehaddashoshot vehaggarosot — osin betzina letzorech hammoed. rabbi yose omer: hem hechemiru al atzman.

Gemara peligi ba rabbi chiyyay bar abba verabbi assi, vetarvayyhu mishshemeh dechizkiyya verabbi yochanan. chad amar: "mechappin" akloshe, "meabbin" asmoche. vechad amar: "mechappin" ben akloshe ben asmoche, "meabbin" — ose oto kemin keri. tanya name hachi: "meabbin" ose oto kemin keri, divre rabbi yehuda.
Mochre ferot kesut vechelim mochrin betzina vechulei. ibbaya lehu: hen hechemiru al atzman — dela havo avdi kelal, o dilma dahavo avdi betzina?

Ta shema: mochre ferot kesut vechelim — mochrin betzina letzorech hammoed, rabbi yose omer: taggare teverya hen hechemiru al atzman shello yehu mochrin kol ikkar. tzade chayyot veofot vedagim — tzadin betzina letzorech hammoed, rabbi yose omer: tzade akko hen hechemiru al atzman shello yehu tzadin kol ikkar. dashoshe chilka targis vetisni — doshshin betzina letzorech hammoed, rabbi yose omer: dashoshe tzippori hen hechmiru al atzman shello yehu doshshin kol ikkar.
Amar abbaye: chilka — chada letarte, targis — chada litlat, tisni — chada learbea. ki ata rav dimi, amar: kunnata.

Metivi: chilka targis vetisni temein bechol makom. bishlama leman deamar chada letarte litlat ulearbea, mishshum hachi temein bechol makom — deittachshur, ella leman deamar kunnata, ammay temein bechol makom, ha la ittachshur?
Kegon demikkallefan, dei lav dishra lehu bemayya la hava mikkalfa. veammay kare leh "chilka" — deshakel chilkayhu.

Metivi: hannoder min haddagan — asur af befol hammitzri yavesh, umuttar belach, umuttar beorez bechilka vetargis vetisni. bishlama leman deamar chada letarte chada litlat vachada learbea — shappir, dinfaku lehu mittorat dagan, ella leman deamar kunnata, dagan mealleya hu! kashya.
Rav huna shera lehu lehanhu kerufeyayta lemezal lezabbone ki orchayyhu beshuka. etiveh rav kahana: chanut petucha listav — poteach venoel kedarko,

Petucha lirshut harabbim — poteach achat venoel achat, veerev yom tov haacharon shel chag motzi umeatter et shuke hair beferot bishvil kevod yom tov haacharon. mippene kevod yom tov haacharon in, shello mippene kevod yom tov la!
La kashya: ha befere, ha betavlin.
Hadaran alach mi shehafach

Veellu megallechin bammoed: habba mimmedinat hayyam umibbet hashshivya, vehayyotze mibbet haasurin, vehamenudde shehittiru lo chachamim, vechen mi shennishal lechacham vehuttar, vehannazir vehammetzora mittumeato letohorato.
Veellu mechabbesin bammoed: habba mimmedinat hayyam umibbet hashshivya, vehayyotze mibbet haasurin,

a: Umenudde shehittiru lo chachamim, vechen mi shennishal lechacham vehuttar.
Mitpechot hayyadayim umitpechot hassefarim umitpechot hassefag, hazzavin vehazzavot vehanniddot vehayyoldot, vechol haolin mittumea letohora — hare ellu muttarin. ushear kol adam asurin.
Gemara ushear kol adam may tama asurin?
Keditnan: anshe mishmar veanshe maamad asurin lesapper ulechabbes, uvachamishi muttarin mippene kevod hashshabbat.
Veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi elazar: may tama — kede shello yikkansu lemishmartan keshehen menuuolin, hacha name: kede shello yikkansu laregel keshehen menuuolin.
Bae rabbi zera: avda lo aveda erev haregel, kevan daanis — muttar, o dilma kevan dela mochcha milleta — la?
Amar abbaye, yomru: kol hasserikin asurin, serike bayytos muttarin?!
Uletamaych, ha deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: kol mi sheen lo ella chaluk echad muttar lechabbeso bechullo shel moed, hatam name, yomru: kol hasserikin asurin, serike bayytos muttarin!
Ha ittemar ala, amar mar bar rav ashe: ezoro mochiach alav.
Rav ashe matne, bae rabbi zera: umman sheavda lo aveda erev haregel, mahu? kevan deumman hu — mochcha milleta, o dilma kevan dela mochcha milleta ki hanach — la? teku.
Mimmedinat hayyam. matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda, detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: habba mimmedinat hayyam — lo yegalleach, mippene sheyyatza shello birshut.
Amar rava: lashut — divre hakkol asur, limzonot — divre hakkol muttar, lo nechleku ella lehervecha. mar medamme leh kelashut, umar medamme leh kelimzonot.

Metivi, amar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi yehuda kesheyyatza shello birshut, vedivre chachamim kesheyyatza birshut. may shello birshut? illema lashut — vehaamrat divre hakkol asur! veella limzonot — vehaamrat divre hakkol muttar! ella peshita, lehervecha.
Ema sefa: nirin devaray chachamim kesheyyatza birshut, may birshut? illema limzonot — ha amrat divre hakkol muttar! veella lehervecha — veha amrat nirin divre rabbi yehuda beha!

Hachi kaamar: nirin divre rabbi yehuda lerabbanan kesheyyatza shello birshut, umay nihu — lashut, sheafillu chachamim lo nechleku alav ella lehervecha, aval lashut — modu leh. venirin divre rabbanan lerabbi yehuda kesheyyatza birshut, umay nihu — limzonot, sheafillu rabbi yehuda lo nechlak alehem ella lehervecha, aval limzonot — mode lehu.
Amar shemuel: katan hannolad bammoed — muttar legalleach bammoed, sheen lecha bet haasurin gadol mizze. bammoed — in, meikkara — la.
Metiv rav pinchas: kol ellu sheamru muttar legalleach bammoed — muttar legalleach bime evlo. ha asur legalleach bammoed — asur legalleach bime evlo.
b: Vei amrat katan it beh pelugeta — nimtzet avelut noheget bekatan.
Vehatanya: mekarin lakkatan, mippene ogmat nefesh!
Amar rav ashe: mi katane ha asurin! dilma yesh mehen asur veyesh mehen muttar.
Ammemar, vei tema rav shisha bereh derav idi, matne hachi. amar shemuel: katan muttar legallecho bammoed, la shena nolad bammoed vela shena nolad meikkara.
Amar rav pinchas, af anan name tenena: kol ellu sheamru muttar legalleach bammoed — muttar legalleach bime evlo. ha asurin legalleach bammoed — asurin legalleach bime evlo.
I amrat katan asur, nimtzet avelut noheget bekatan. vetanya: mekarin lakkatan mippene ogmat nefesh.
Amar rav ashe: mi katane ha asurin? dilma yesh mehen asur veyesh mehen muttar.
Avel eno noheg aveluto baregel, shenneemar: "vesamachta bechaggecha".
I avelut demeikkara hu — ate ase derabbim vedache ase deyachid. vei avelut dehashta hu — la ate ase deyachid vedache ase derabbim.
Menudda, mahu sheyyinhog nidduyo baregel? amar rav yosef, ta shema: danin dine nefashot vedine makkot vedine mamonot, vei la tzayet dina — meshammetinan leh.
Vei salka datach eno noheg nidduyo baregel, meshummat veate meikkara, ate regel dache leh — hasheta meshammetinan leh anan?!
Amar leh abbaye: vedilma leayyone bedineh? dei la tema hachi, dine nefashot dekatane, hacha name dekatlin leh!
Veha ka mimmani missimchat yom tov — detanya, rabbi akiva omer: minnayin lesanhedrin (sherau beechad) shehargu et hannefesh sheen toamin kol oto hayyom, talmud lomar: "lo tochlu al haddam".
Ella: leayyone bedineh, hacha name leayyone bedineh. amar leh: im ken, nimtzeta meanne et dino!
Atu mitztzafra umeayyeyni bedineh, veayyli, veachli veshatu kulle yoma, vahadar atu bishkiat hachamma vegamri ledineh vekatlu leh.
Amar abbaye, ta shema: umenudde shehittiru lo chachamim!
Amar rava: mi katane shehittiruhu chachamim? shehittiru lo chachamim katane, daazal ufayyeyseh levaal dineh, vaata kamme derabbanan ushero leh.
Metzora, mahu sheyyanhig tzarato baregel? amar abbaye, ta shema: vehannazir vehammetzora mittumeato letohorato. ha bime tumeato — naheg.
La mibbaya kaamar. la mibbaya bime tumeato dela naheg, aval letohorato nigzor shemma yeshahe korbenotav, kamashma lan!

Amar rava, ta shema: "vehatztzarua" — lerabbot kohen gadol. veha kohen gadol, dechol hashshana keregel lechulle alma dame, ditnan: kohen gadol makriv onen veeno ochel. shema minna noheg tzarato baregel. shema minna.
Avel asur betisporet. middekaamar lehu rachamana livne aharon: "rashechem al tifrau", mikkelal dechulle alma asur.

a: Menuddin umetzorain ma hen betisporet? ta shema: menuddin umetzorain asurin lesapper ulechabbes.

Menudde shemmet, bet din soklin et arono. rabbi yehuda omer: lo sheyyaamidu alav gal avanim kegallo shel achan, ella bet din sholchin umannichin even gedola al arono, lelammedcha shekkol hammitnadde umet benidduyo — bet din soklin et arono.
Avel chayyayv baatifat harosh. middekaamar leh rachamana lichezkel: "velo tate al safam", mikkelal dechulle alma michayyeyvi.

Menudde mahu baatifat harosh? amar rav yosef, ta shema: vehen mitattefin veyoshvin kimnuddin vechaavelim ad sheyyerachamu alehem min hashshamayim. amar leh abbaye: dilma menudde lashshamayim shane, dachamir.
Metzora mahu baatifat harosh? ta shema: "veal safam yate", mikkelal shechayyayv baatifat harosh. shema minna.
Avel asur lehanniach tefillin, middekaamar leh rachamana lichezkel: "peercha chavosh alecha", mikkelal dechulle alma asur.

Menudde mahu bitfillin? teku. metzora mahu bitfillin? ta shema: "vehatztzarua" — lerabbot kohen gadol. "begadav yihyu ferumim" — sheyyehu mekoraim, "verosho yihye farua" — en peria ella giddul sear, divre rabbi eliezer.
Rabbi akiva omer: neemra havayay barosh, veneemra havayay babbeged. ma havayay haamura babbeged — davar shechutz miggufo. af havayay barosh davar shechutz miggufo. may lav, attefillin!
Amar rav pappa: la, akkumeta vesudara.
Avel asur bishelat shalom. dekaamar leh rachamana lichezkel: "heanek dom".
Menudde mahu bishelat shalom? amar rav yosef, ta shema: uvishelat shalom shebben adam lachavero kivne adam hannezufin lammakom. amar leh abbaye: dilma menudde lashshamayim shane, dachamir.
Metzora mahu bishelat shalom? ta shema: "veal safam yate" — sheyyehu siftotav medubbakot zo bazo, sheyyehe kimnudde ucheavel, veasur bishelat shalom. shema minna.
Venifshot minna limnudde? amar rav acha bar pinchas mishshemeh derav yosef: mi katane sheasur? sheyyehe kimnudde ucheavel [katane] bemille achranyayta, veasur name bishelat shalom.
Avel asur bedivre tora, middekaamar rachamana lichezkel: "dom".
Menudde mahu bedivre tora? amar rav yosef, ta shema: menudde shone veshonin lo, niskar veniskarin lo.
Mucheram — lo shone velo shonin lo, lo niskar velo niskarin lo. aval shone hu leatzmo, shello yafsik et limmudo, veose lo chanut ketanna bishvil parnasato.
Veamar rav — zabbone mayya befakta daaravot. shema minna.
Metzora mahu bedivre tora? ta shema: "vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha. yom asher amadta lifne Adonai elohecha bechorev" — ma lehallan beema uveyira uvirtet uvezia,
Mikkan amru: hazzavin vehametzorain uvoale niddot — muttarin likrot battora uvanneviim uvakketuvim, velishnot bammidrash uvattalmud, bahalachot uvaaggadot. uvaale kerayin asurin. shema minna.

Avel asur betichboset, dichtiv: "vayyishlach yoav tekoa vayyikkach mishsham ishsha chachama vayyomer eleha hitabbeli na velivshi na vigde evel veal tasuchi shemen vehayit keishsha ze yamim rabbim mitabbelet al met".
Menuddin umetzorain ma hen betichboset? ta shema: menuddin umetzorain asurin lesapper ulechabbes. shema minna.
Avel chayyayv bikria, dekaamar lehu rachamana livne aharon: "lo tifromu", mikkelal dechulle alma michayyeyvi.
Menudde mahu bikria? teku.
Metzora mahu bikria? ta shema: "begadav yihyu ferumim" — sheyyehu mekorain. shema minna.
Avel chayyayv bichfiyyayt hammitta, detane bar kappara:
b: Demut deyokni natatti bahen, uvaavonotehem hafachtiha. (kafu) [yehafchu] mittotehen aleha. menudde umetzora ma hen bichfiyyayt hammitta? teku.
Avel asur baasiyyayt melacha, dichtiv: "vehafachti chaggechem leevel". ma chag asur bimlacha — af avel asur bimlacha.

Menudde mahu baasiyyayt melacha? amar rav yosef, ta shema: kesheamru asur baasiyyayt melacha, lo amru ella bayyom, aval ballayla muttar. vechen atta motze bimnudde uveavel. may lav, akkullehu? la, ashsheara.
Ta shema: menudde shone veshonin lo, niskar veniskarin lo. shema minna. metzora mahu baasiyyayt melacha? teku.
Avel asur birchitza, dichtiv: "veal tasuchi shemen", urechitza bichlal sicha.

Menudde mahu birchitza? amar rav yosef, ta shema: kesheamru asur birchitza lo amru ella kol gufo, aval panav yadav veraglav — muttar, vechen atta motze bimnudde uveavel. may lav akkullehu? la, ashsheara. metzora mahu birchitza? teku.
Avel asur binilat hassandal, middekaamar leh rachamana lichezkel "unealecha tasim beraglecha", mikkelal dechulle alma asur.

Menudde mahu binilat hassandal? amar rav yosef, ta shema: kesheamru asur binilat hassandal — lo amru ella bair, aval badderech — muttar. ha ketzad? yatza ladderech — noel, nichnas lair — choletz, vechen atta motze bimnudde uveavel. may lav akkullehu? la, ashsheara.
Metzora mahu binilat hassandal? teku.
Avel asur betashmish hammitta, dichtiv: "vaynachem david et bat sheva ishto vayyavo eleha", mikkelal demeikkara asur.

Menudde mahu betashmish hammitta? amar rav yosef, ta shema: kol otan shanim shehayu yisrael bammidbar menuddin hayu, veshimmeshu mittotehen. amar leh abbaye: vedilma menudde lashshamayim shane, dekil.
Kil?! veha amrat chamir! sappoke mesappeka leh: zil hacha kamdache leh, vezil hacha kamdache leh.

Metzora mahu betashmish hammitta? ta shema, detanya: "veyashav michutz leoholo", sheyyehe kimnudde ucheavel, veasur betashmish hammitta. veen "oholo" ella ishto, shenneemar: "lech emor lahem shuvu lachem leoholechem". shema minna.
Venifshot name limnudde? amar rav huna bereh derav pinchas mishshemeh derav yosef: mi katane sheasur? sheyyehe kimnudde ucheavel bemille achranyayta, veasur name betashmish hammitta.
Avel eno meshalleach korbenotav, detanya, rabbi shimon omer: "shelamim" — bizman shehu shalem, velo bizman shehu onen.

Menudde mahu sheyyeshallach korbenotav? amar rav yosef, ta shema: kol otan shanim shehayu yisrael bammidbar menuddin hayu, veshillechu korbenotehen. amar leh abbaye: vedilma menudde lashshamayim shane, dekil?
Kil?! vehaamrat chamir? sappoke mesappeka leh umedache leh.

Metzora mahu sheyyeshallach korbenotav? ta shema, detanya: "veachare tohorato" — achar perishato min hammet, "shivat yamim yisperu lo" — ellu shivat yeme sefiro, "uveyom boo el hakkodesh el hechatzer happenimit lesharet bakkodesh yakriv chattato" —

a: Zo asirit haefa shello, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi shimon omer: "bevoo yakriv", bizman sherauy levia — rauy lehakerava, bizman sheeno rauy levia — eno rauy lehakerava.

Amar rava: menalan dimshadderin shelicha deve dina umazmeninan leh ledina — dichtiv: "vayyishlach moshe likro ledatan velaaviram bene eliav". umenalan demazmeninan ledina — dichtiv: "vayyomer moshe el korach atta vechol adatcha".

Lekamme gavra rabba — dichtiv: "lifne Adonai". at ufelanya — dichtiv: "atta vahem veaharon". dekavinan zimna — dichtiv: "machar". zimna batar zimna — dichtiv: "karu sham paro melech mitzrayim shaon heevir hammoed".
Umenalan dei mitpakkar bishlicha deve dina, veate veamar, la mitchaze kelishshana bisha — dichtiv: "haene haanashim hahem tenakker".
Umenalan dimshammetinan — dichtiv: "oru meroz". dehachi sevara degavra rabba — dichtiv: "amar malach Adonai". umenalan demachreminan — dichtiv: "oru aror".
Deachel veshate bahadeh vekae bearba ammot dideh — dichtiv: "yoshveha". umenalan defartinan chiteh betzibbura — dichtiv: "ki lo vau leezrat Adonai".
Veamar ulla: bearba mea shippure shammeteh barak lemeroz. ikka deamri gavra rabba hava, veikka deamri kochva hava, shenneemar: "min shamayim nilchamu hakkochavim".
Umenalan demafkerinan nichseh — dichtiv: "vechol asher lo yavo lishloshet hayyamim baatzat hassarim vehazzekenim yochoram kol rechusho vehu yibbadel mikkehal haggola".
Umenalan denatzenan velayytinan umachenan vetalshinan sear umashbeinan — dichtiv: "vaariv immam vaakallem vaakke mehem anashim vaemretem vaashbiem".

Umenalan dechaftinan veasrinan veavdinan haredafa — dichtiv: "hen lemot hen lishroshi hen laanash nichsin velaasurin". may lishroshi? amar adda mari amar nechemya bar baruch amar rav chiyyay bar avin amar rav yehuda: haredafa. may haredafa? amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav: menaddin lealtar, veshonin leachar sheloshim, umachrimin leachar shishshim.
Amar leh rav huna bar chinnana, hachi amar rav chisda: matrin beh sheni vachamishi vesheni. hane mille lemamona, aval leafkeruta — lealtar.

Hahu tabbacha deitpakkar berav tovi bar matna, immeno aleh abbaye verava veshammetuhu, lesof azal payyeyseh levaal dineh. amar abbaye: hechi lebed? lishre leh — la chal shamta aleh telatin yomin. la lishre leh — ka bau rabbanan lemeal.

Amar leh lerav idi bar avin: midde shemia lach beha? amar leh: hachi amar rav tachlifa bar avimi amar shemuel: tut asar vetut share. amar leh: hane mille lemamona, aval leafkeruta — ad dechayyla shamta aleh telatin yomin.
Alma kasavar abbaye: hane be telata deshammitu — la atu telata acharine vesharu leh.
Deibbaya lehu: hane be telata deshammitu, mahu lemete telata acharine vesharu leh? ta shema: menudde larav — menudde lattalmid, menudde lattalmid — eno menudde larav.

Menudde leiro — menudde leir acheret, menudde leir acheret — eno menudde leiro. menudde lannasi — menudde lechol yisrael, menudde lechol yisrael — eno menudde lannasi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: echad min hattalmidim shennidda vamet — chelko eno mufar.
Shema minna telat: shema minna talmid shennidda lichvodo — nidduyo nidduy, ushema minna kol echad veechad mefer chelko, ushema minna hane be telata deshammitu, la atu telata acharine vesharu leh.

Amar ammemar: hilcheta, hane be telata deshammitu — atu be telata acharine vesharu leh. amar leh rav ashe leammemar: veha tanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: echad min hattalmidim shennidda vamet — chelko eno mufar. may lav, eno mufar kelal! la, ad deatu be telata acharine vesharu leh.

Tanu rabbanan: en nidduy pachot mishsheloshim yom, veen nezifa pachot mishshiva yamim. veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar, shenneemar: "veaviha yarok yarak befaneha halo tikkalem shivat yamim".

Amar rav chisda: nidduy shellanu kinzifa shellahen, unezifa didhu shiva vetu la. veha rabbi shimon bar rabbi uvar kappara havo yatvi veka garsi, kashya lehu shemata, amar leh rabbi shimon levar kappara: davar ze tzarich rabbi. amar leh bar kappara lerabbi shimon: uma rabbi omer bedavar ze?
Azal amar leh laavu, ikkefad. ata bar kappara leitchazoye leh, amar leh: bar kappara, eni makkircha meolam! yeda dinkat milleta bedateh, nehag nezifuta benafsheh telatin yomin.
Shuv paam echad gazar rabbi shello yishnu lattalmidim bashshuk, may derash — "chammuke yerechayich kemo chalaim". ma yarech basseter,
b: Af divre tora basseter.

Yatza rabbi chiyyay veshana lishne bene echav bashshuk, lerav ulerabba bar (bar) chana. shema rabbi, ikkefad. ata rabbi chiyyay leitchazoye leh, amar leh: iyyay, mi kore lecha bachutz! yeda dinkat milleta bedateh, nehag nezifuta benafsheh telatin yomin.
Beyom telatin shelach leh: ta. hadar shelach leh dela lete.
