Meikkara may sevar ulevassof may sevar? meikkara savar: miktzat hayyom kechullo. ulevassof savar: la amrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo.
Lesof ata. amar leh: ammay atet? amar leh: deshalach li mar delete. veha shelachi lach dela tete! amar leh: ze raiti, veze lo raiti. kare aleh: "birtzot Adonai darche ish gam oyvav yashlim itto".
May tama avad mar hachi? amar leh, dichtiv: "chochmot bachutz taronna". amar leh: im karita — lo shanita, veim shanita — lo shillashta, veim shillashta — lo pershu lecha.
"Chochmot bachutz taronna", kidrava. deamar rava: kol haosek battora mibbifnim, torato machrezet alav mibbachutz.
Veha ketiv: "lo merosh basseter dibbarti"! hahu beyome dechalla.
Verabbi chiyyay, hay "chammuke yerechayich" may aved le? moke le bitzdaka uvigmilut chasadim.
Alma nezifa didhu telatin yomin! nezifat nasi shane.

Unezifa didan kamma have? chad yoma. ki ha dishmuel umar ukeva, ki havo yatvi garsi shemata, hava yatev mar ukeva kammeh dishmuel berachok arba ammot. vechi havo yatvi bedina, hava yatev shemuel kammeh demar ukeva berachok arba ammot. vahavo chayyki leh ducheta lemar ukeva betzippeta, veyatev illaveh ki hechi delishtaman milleh.

Kol yoma hava melavi leh mar ukeva lishmuel ad ushepizeh. yoma chad itterid bedineh hava azel shemuel batreh. ki meta leveteh, amar leh: la nega lach? lishre li mar betigreh! yeda dinkat milleta bedateh, nehag nezifuta benafsheh chad yoma.

Hahi itteta dahavot yatva bishvila, havot pashta kara veka menifa chushelae, vahava chalef veazel tzureba merabbanan vela ikkana mikkammeh. amar: kamma chatztzifa hahi itteta! atay lekammeh derav nachman. amar la: mi shemat shamta mippummeh? amara leh: la. amar la: zili nehugi nezifuta chad yoma benafshich.
Zutera bar toviyya hava kafasek sidra kammeh derav yehuda, ki meta lehay pesuka "veelle divre david haacharonim", amar leh: "acharonim" — mikkelal deikka rishonim, rishonim may ninhu?

Shetek vela amar leh vela midde, hadar amar leh: "acharonim", mikkelal deikka rishonim, rishonim may hi? amar leh: may datach, dela yada perusha dehay kera lav gavra rabba hu? yeda dinkat milleta bedateh, nehag nezifuta benafsheh chad yoma.
Vedaatan ala, miha "acharonim" — mikkelal deikka rishonim, rishonim may hi? "vaydabber david laAdonai et divre hashshira hazzot beyom hitztzil Adonai oto mikkaf kol oyvav umikkaf shaul".
Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu ledavid: david, shira atta omer al mappalto shel shaul? ilmale atta shaul vehu david — ibbadti kamma david mippanav.
Hayeynu dichtiv: "shiggayon ledavid asher shar laAdonai al divre chush ben yemini", vechi kush shemo? vahalo shaul shemo! ella: ma kushi meshunne beoro — af shaul meshunne bemaasav.

Kayyotze baddavar atta omer: "al odot haishsha hakkushit asher lakach", vechi kushit shemah? vahalo tzippora shemah! ella: ma kushit meshunna beorah — af tzippora meshunna bemaaseha. kayyotze baddavar atta omer: "vayyishma eved melech hakkushi", vechi kushi shemo? vahalo tzidkiyya shemo! ella: ma kushi meshunne beoro — af tzidkiyya meshunne bemaasav.

Kayyotze baddavar atta omer: "halo chivne chushiyyim attem li bet yisrael", vechi kushiyyim sheman? vahalo yisrael sheman! ella: ma kushi meshunne beoro — af yisrael meshunnin bemaasehen mikkol haummot.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan, may dichtiv: "neum david ben yishay uneum haggever hukam al" — neum david ben yishay shehekim ullah shel teshuva.

"Amar elohe yisrael li dibber tzur yisrael moshel baadam tzaddik moshel yirat elohim". may kaamar? amar rabbi avahu, hachi kaamar: amar elohe yisrael, li dibber tzur yisrael, ani moshel baadam, mi moshel bi — tzaddik, sheani gozer gezera umevattelah.
"Elle shemot haggibborim asher ledavid yoshev bashshevet vegomer". may kaamar? amar rabbi avahu, hachi kaamar: veelle shemot gevurotav shel david.

"Yoshev bashshevet" — beshaa shehaya yoshev bishiva, lo haya yoshev al gabbe karim uchesatot ella al gabbe karka. dechol kamma dahava rabbeh ira hayyairi kayyaym, hava matne lehu lerabbanan al gabbe karim uchesatot. ki nach nafsheh, hava matni david lerabbanan vahava yatev al gabbe karka. amaru leh: littev mar akkarim uchesatot! la kabbel aleh.
"Tachkemoni", amar rav: amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu, hoil vehishpalta atzmecha tehe kamoni. sheani gozer gezera, veatta mevattelah.
"Rosh hashshalishim" — tehe rosh lishloshet avot. "hu adino haetzni", keshehaya yoshev veosek battora — haya meadden atzmo ketolaat, uveshaa sheyyotze lammilchama — haya makshe atzmo keetz.
"Al shemone meot chalal befaam echat". shehaya zorek chetz, umappil shemone meot chalal befaam echat, vehaya mitanneach al matayim, dichtiv: "echa yirdof echad elef".
Yatzta bat kol veamra: "rak bidvar uriyya hachitti".
Amar rabbi tanchum bereh derabbi chiyyay ish kefar akko, amar rabbi yaakov bar acha amar rabbi simlay. veamri la, amar rabbi tanchum amar rav huna, veamri la amar rav huna lechodeh:

a: Talmid shennidda lichvodo — nidduyo nidduy, detanya: menudde larav — menudde lattalmid, menudde lattalmid — eno menudde larav. larav hu deeno menudde, ha lechulle alma — menudde.
Lemay? i bemille dishmayya — "en chochma veen tevuna veen etza leneged Adonai"! ella lav, lichvod atzmo.
Amar rav yosef: tzureba merabbanan aved dina lenafsheh bemilleta difsika leh.
Hahu tzureba merabbanan dahavo senu shumeaneh, amar rav yehuda: hechi lebed? leshammeteh — tzerichi leh rabbanan, la leshammeteh — ka mittechil shema dishmayya.

Amar leh lerabba bar bar chana: midde shemia lach beha? amar leh, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv: "ki sifte chohen yishmeru daat vetora yevakshu mippihu ki malach Adonai tzevaot hu". im dome harav lemalach Adonai — yevakkeshu tora mippiv, veim lav — al yevakkeshu tora mippiv.
Shammeteh rav yehuda. lesof ichalash rav yehuda. ato rabbanan leshayyole beh vaata ihu name bahadayyhu, kad chazyeh rav yehuda, chayyech.

Amar leh: la missatyeh deshammeteh lehahu gavra, ella achoche name chayyech bi?! amar leh: lav bedidach mechayyechna, ella dechi azelna lehahu alma bedicha datay, daafillu legavra kevotach la channefi leh.

Nach nafsheh derav yehuda. ata leve midresha, amar lehu: shero li! amaru leh rabbanan: gavra dachashiv kerav yehuda lekka hacha delishre lach, ella zil legabbeh derabbi yehuda nesia delishre lach. azal lekammeh, amar leh lerabbi amme: pok ayyen bedineh, i mibbee lemishre leh — sheri leh.

Ayyen rabbi amme bedineh, sevar lemishre leh. amad rabbi shemuel bar nachmani al raglav veamar: uma shifcha shel bet rabbi lo nahagu chachamim kallut rosh benidduyah shalosh shanim, yehuda chaverenu al achat kamma vechamma.
Amar rabbi zera: may dekamman daata haiddana hay sava beve midresha, deha kamma shene la ata, shema minna la mibbee lemishre leh. la shera leh, nefak ki ka vache veazel,
Ata zibbura vetarkeh aammeteh ushechev. ayyeylu limarta dachaside vela kayblu, ayyeylu limarta dedayyayne vekayblu.

May tama? daavad kerabbi ilay. detanya, rabbi ilay omer: im roe adam sheyyitzro mitgabber alav — yelech lemakom sheen makkirin oto, veyilbash shechorim veyitattef shechorim, veyaase ma shellibbo chafetz, veal yechallel shem shamayim befarhesya.

Shifcha shel bet rabbi may hi? deammeta deve rabbi chazeteh lehahu gavra dahava mache livno gadol, amara: leheve hahu gavra beshamta, dekaaver mishshum "velifne ivver lo titten michshol". detanya: "velifne ivver lo titten michshol" — bemakke livno gadol hakkatuv medabber.

Resh lakish hava menattar pardesa. ata hahu gavra vekaachel teene, rema beh kala vela ashgach beh. amar: leheve hahu gavra beshamta. amar leh: adderabba, leheve hahu gavra beshamta, im mamon nitchayyayvti lecha, nidduy mi nitchayyayvti lach?
Ata leve midresha, amaru leh: shello — nidduy, shellecha — eno nidduy.
Umay takkanteh? zil legabbeh delishre lach. la yadana leh. amaru leh: zil legabbe nesia delishre lach, detanya: nidduhu veeno yodea mi niddahu, yelech etzel nasi veyattir lo nidduyo.
Amar rav huna, beusha hitkinu: av bet din shessarach — en menaddin oto, ella omer lo: "hikkaved veshev bevetecha". chazar vesarach — menaddin oto, mippene chillul hashshem.
Ufeliga deresh lakish. deamar resh lakish: talmid chacham shessarach — en menaddin oto befarhesya, shenneemar: "vechashalta hayyom vechashal gam navi immecha layla" — kassehu kallayla.
Mar zutera chasida, ki michayyayv tzureba merabbanan shamta, beresha meshammet nafsheh, vahadar meshammet ledideh. ki hava ayel beushepizeh share leh lenafsheh, vahadar share leh ledideh.

Amar rav giddel amar rav: talmid chacham menadde leatzmo, umefer leatzmo. amar rav pappa: tete li, dela shammeti tzureba merabbanan meolam. ella ki ka michayyayv tzureba merabbanan shamta, hechi aved? ki ha divmareva mimmenu annegada detzureba merabbanan vela mimmenu ashshamta.
May shamta? amar rav: sham mita. ushemuel amar: shemama yihye, umahneya beh ki tichya betannura.
Ufeliga deresh lakish. deamar resh lakish: keshem shennichneset bematayim vearbaim ushemona evarim, kach keshehi yotza — yotza mimmatayim vearbaim ushemona evarim.
Keshehi nichneset, dichtiv: "vehayta hair cherem" — "cherem" begimatriyya matayim vearbaim ushemona havu. keshehi yotza, dichtiv: "berogez rachem tizkor", "rachem" begimatriyya hachi havu.
Amar rav yosef: shedi shamta aggenuveta dechalba veihi dida avda. dehahu kalba dahava achel mesane derabbanan vela havo ka yadi mannu, veshammitu leh. ittelay beh nura bignuveteh vaachalteh.
Hahu allama dahava ka metzaar leh lehahu tzureba merabbanan, ata lekammeh derav yosef, amar leh: zil shamteh. amar leh: mistefena minneh.
Amar leh: shekel peticha aleh. kol shekken demistefena minneh. amar leh: shikleh, achateh bechadda,
b: Veachateh be kivre, ukeri beh alpa shippure bearbein yomin. azel aved hachi, peka kadda umit allama. may shippure — shennifrain mimmennu.
May tevara? amar rav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda: tavri batte rame. detanya, amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: kol makom shennatnu chachamim enehem", o mita o oni.
Vehannazir vehammetzora mittumeato letohorato. bea minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: beshello haya lahem penay, o dilma af beshehaya lahem penay?
Amar leh, tenena: kol ellu sheamru muttarin legalleach bammoed — beshello haya lahem penay, aval haya lahem penay — asurim.
Nazir umetzora, af al pi shehaya lahem penay — muttarim, shello yeshahu korbenotehen.

Tana: hakkohen vehaavel muttarin begilluach. hay avel hechi dame? illema shechal shemini shello beerev haregel — ibbei leh legalloche baerev haregel! ella, shechal shemini shello lihyot beshabbat erev haregel.

Ibbei leh legalloche erev shabbat, deamar rav chisda amar ravina bar shela: halacha keabba shaul, umodim chachamim leabba shaul beshechal shemini shello lihyot beshabbat erev haregel shemmuttar legalleach beerev shabbat!
La tzericha, shechal shevii shello lihyot beshabbat erev haregel.
Tanna bara savar la keabba shaul, deamar: miktzat hayyom kechullo, veyom shevii ole lo lechan ulechan. vechevan deshabbat have — anus hu.
Tanna didan savar la kerabbanan, deamri: la amrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo, veakkatti la shelim avelut deshiva.
Hay kohen hechi dame? illema dishlim mishmarto erev haregel — ibbei leh legalloche erev haregel!

La tzericha, dishlim mishmarto baregel. tanna didan savar, kevan ditnan: bishlosha perakim bashshana hayu kol hammishmarot shavot, beemure hargalim, uvechilluk lechem happanim — keman dela shelim mishmarto baregel dame. vetanna bara savar: af al gav deshayech behanach mishmarot, mishmarteh miha shelima leh.
Tanu rabbanan: kol ellu sheamru muttarin legalleach bammoed — muttarin legalleach bime evlan.
Vehatanya: asurim! amar rav chisda amar rav shela: ki tanya hacha muttarin — beshettechafuhu avalav.
I beshettechafuhu avalav, may irya kol ellu sheamru, afillu kulle alma name? detanya: techafuhu avalav ze achar ze, hichbid searo — mekel betaar, umechabbes kesuto bemayim.
Ha ittemar ala, amar rav chisda: betaar velo bemisparayim, bemayim velo beneter velo beahal. amar rav chisda: zot omeret avel asur betichboset.
Tanu rabbanan: keshem sheamru asur legalleach bammoed, kach asur littol tzippornayim bammoed, divre rabbi yehuda. verabbi yose mattir.
Ucheshem sheamru avel asur legalleach bime evlo — kach asur littol tzippornayim bime evlo, divre rabbi yehuda. verabbi yose mattir.
Amar ulla: halacha kerabbi yehuda beevel, vahalacha kerabbi yose bammoed. shemuel amar:

a: Halacha kerabbi yose bammoed uveevel, deamar shemuel: halacha kedivre hammekel beevel.

Pinchas achu demar shemuel ittera beh milleta, al shemuel lemishal tama minneh. chazanhu letufere[] dahavo nefishan, amar leh: ammay la shaklat lehu? amar leh: i bedideh hava, mi mezalzelat beh kulle hay?

Havay "kishgaga sheyyotza millifne hashshallit", veittera beh milleta bishmuel. al pinchas achu lemishal tama minneh. shaklinhu letufereh chavtinhu leappeh. amar leh: let lacha berit keruta lassefatayim?

Deamar rabbi yochanan: minnayin shebberit keruta lassefatayim — shenneemar: "vayyomer avraham el nearav shevu lachem po im hachamor vaani vehannaar nelcha ad ko venishtachave venashuva alechem", veistayyeya milleta dahadur tarvayyhu.
Sevur minneh deyad — in, deregel — la. amar rav anan bar tachlifa: ledidi mipparsha li minneh dishmuel: la shena deyad vela shena deregel.
Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: uvignusetra — asur. amar rav shemen bar abba: hava kaemna kammeh derabbi yochanan be midresha bechullo shel moed, veshaklinhu letufereh beshinneh vezarkinhu.
Shema minna telat. shema minna: muttar littol tzippornayim bechullo shel moed, ushema minna: en bahen mishshum mius, ushema minna: muttar lezorkan.
Ini? vehatanya, shelosha devarim neemru batztzippornayim: hakkovran — tzaddik, sorfan — chasid, zorkan — rasha. tama may — shemma taavor alehen ishsha ubbarah vetappil.
Ishsha be midresha la shechicha. vechi tema: zimnin dimychanneshi lehu veshade lehu abbaray — kevan deishtanni ishtanni.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: zug ba mechammatan lifne rabbi, umar zutera matne: zug ba mechammatan lifne rabbi, uvikkeshu mimmennu tzippornayim — vehittir lahem. veim bikkeshu mimmennu safa — hittir lahem, ushemuel amar: af bikkeshu mimmennu safa, vehittir lahem.
Amar avitul safra mishshemeh derav pappa: safa mizzavit lezavit. amar rabbi amme: uvesafa hameakkevet. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ledidi kesafa hameakkevet dame li.
Vaamar avitul safra mishshemeh derav pappa: paro shehaya bime moshe, hu amma, uzekano amma, ufarmashteko amma vazeret, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "ushefal anashim yakim aleha".
Vaamar avitul safra mishshemeh derav pappa: paro shehaya bime moshe amgushi haya, shenneemar: "hinne yotze hammayma vegomer".
Veellu mechabbesin bammoed, habba mimmedinat hayyam. amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: mi sheen lo ella chaluk echad — muttar lechabbeso bechullo shel moed.
Metiv rabbi yirmeya: ellu mechabbesin bammoed, habba mimmedinat hayyam kulei. hane in, mi sheen lo ella chaluk echad — la!
Amar leh rabbi yaakov lerabbi yirmeya: asbera lach, matnitin af al gav deit leh tere umittannefi.
Shelach rav yitzchak bar yaakov bar giyyore mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: kele fishtan — muttar lechabbesan bechullo shel moed. metiv rava: mitpechot hayyadayim, mitpechot
b: Hassapparim. hane — in, kele fishtan — la.
Amar leh abbaye: matnitin afillu dishar mine. amar bar hidya: ledidi chaze li yammah shel teverya, demappeki la meshichle demane kittana bechulla demoada.
Matkef la abbaye: man lema lan divratzon chachamim avdi, dilma shello birtzon chachamim avdi.
Mishna veellu kotvin bammoed: kiddushe nashim vegittin veshovarin. deyayteke, mattana uferozbulin. iggerot shum veiggerot mazon.
Shetare chalitza umeunim ushetare verurin. gezerot bet din veiggerot shel reshut.
Gemara amar shemuel: muttar leares ishsha bechullo shel moed, shemma yikdemennu acher. lema mesayyay leh: veellu kotvin bammoed — kiddushe nashim,
May lav shetare kiddushin mammash? la, shetare fesikata, vechidrav giddel amar rav.
Deamar rav giddel amar rav: kamma atta noten levincha? kach vechach. kamma atta noten levittecha? kach vechach. amdu vekiddeshu kanu, hen hen haddevarim hanniknin baamira.
Lema mesayyay leh: en nosin nashim bammoed, lo betulot velo almanot. velo meyabbemin, mippene shessimcha hi lo. ha leares — share.
La mibbaya kaamar. la mibbaya leares — dela kaaved mitzva, ella afillu lissa name, deka aved mitzva, asur.
Ta shema, detana deve shemuel: mearsin, aval lo konsin. veen osin seudat erusin, velo meyabbemin, mippene shessimcha hi lo. shema minna.
Umi amar shemuel shemma yikdemennu acher? vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: bechol yom veyom bat kol yotzet veomeret: bat peloni lifloni, sede feloni lifloni.
Ella: shemma yikdemennu acher berachamim.

Ki ha derava shameh lehahu gavra devae rachame veamar: tizdemen li pelanita. amar leh: la tive rachame hachi. i chazya lach — la azla minnach, vei la — kafrat baAdonai. batar hachi, shameh dekaamar: o ihu lemut mikkamma, o ihi temut mikkammeh. amar leh: lav amena lach la tive ala demilleta?

Hachi amar rav mishshum rabbi reuven ben itzterovili: min hattora umin hanneviim umin hakketuvim — meAdonai ishsha leish. min hattora, dichtiv: "vayyaan lavan uvetuel vayyomru meAdonai yatza haddavar". min hanneviim, dichtiv: "veaviv veimmo lo yadu ki meAdonai hi". min hakketuvim, dichtiv: "bayit vahon nachalat avot ume ishsha maskalet".

Veamar rav mishshum rabbi reuven ben itzterovili, veamri la bematnita tana, amar rabbi reuven ben itzterovili: en adam nechshad bedavar ella im ken asao, veim lo asa kullo — asa miktzato, veim lo asa miktzato — hirher belibbo laasoto, veim lo hirher belibbo laasoto — raa acherim sheasu vesamach.
Metiv rabbi yaakov: "vaychappeu vene yisrael devarim asher lo chen al Adonai elohehem"! hatam lehacheis hu daavud.
Ta shema: "vaykanu lemoshe bammachane leaharon kedosh Adonai", rav shemuel bar yitzchak amar: melammed shekkol echad kinne leishto mimmoshe! hatam mishshum sina hu daavud.
Ta shema, amar rabbi yose: yehe chelki im mi shechoshdin oto bedavar veen bo. veamar rav pappa: ledidi chashdun vela hava bi!
La kashya: ha bekala defasek, ha bekala dela pasek. vekala dela pasek ad kamma? amar abbaye, amara li em: dome demata yoma ufalga.
Vehane mille dela pesak bene bene, aval pesak bene bene — let lan ba. vechi pesak bene bene, la amaran ella dela pesak mechamat yira, aval pesak mechamat yira — la.
Vela amaran, ella dela hadar navet, aval hadar navet — la. vela amaran ella delet leh oyvim, aval it leh oyvim — oyvim hu deappeku lekala.
Mishna en kotvin shetare chov bammoed. veim eno maamino, o sheen lo ma yochal — hare ze yichtov.
En kotvin sefarim tefillin umezuzot bammoed, veen maggihin ot achat afillu besefer ezra. rabbi yehuda omer: kotev adam tefillin umezuzot leatzmo,

a: Vetove al yerecho techelet letzitzito.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: kotev adam tefillin umezuzot leatzmo, vetove al yerecho techelet letzitzito, velaacherim betova, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: maarim, umocher et shello, vechozer vechotev leatzmo. rabbi yose omer: kotev umocher kedarko kede farnasato.
Ori leh rav lerav chananel, veamri la rabba bar bar chana lerav chananel: halacha, kotev umocher kedarko kede farnasato.

Vetove al yerecho techelet. tanu rabbanan: tove adam al yerecho techelet letzitzito, aval lo beeven, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim: af beeven. rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo: beeven aval lo befelech, vachachamim omrim: ben beeven ben befelech.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel, vechen amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: halacha ben beeven ben befelech. vahalacha: kotev kedarko umocher kede farnasato.
Mishna hakkover et meto shelosha yamim kodem laregel — batla hemennu gezerat shiva. shemona — batlu hemennu gezerat sheloshim.
Mippene sheamru: shabbat ola, veenah mafseket. regalim mafsikin, veenan olin.
Rabbi eliezer omer: mishshecharav bet hammikdash, atzeret kashshabbat.
Rabban gamliel omer: rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim kargalim. vachachamim omrim: lo kedivre ze velo kedivre ze, ella: atzeret kargalim, rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim kashshabbat.
Gemara amar rav: gezerot — batlu, yamim — lo batlu, vechen amar rabbi huna: gezerot — batlu, yamim — lo batlu. verav sheshet amar: afillu yamim name batlu.
May tama yamim lo batlu? sheim lo gillach erev haregel — asur legalleach achar haregel.
b: Vehatanya: hakkover et meto shelosha yamim kodem laregel — batla hemennu gezerat shiva, shemona yamim kodem laregel — batla hemennu gezerat sheloshim, umegalleach erev haregel. im lo gillach erev haregel — asur legalleach achar haregel.
Abba shaul omer: muttar legalleach achar haregel, shekkeshem shemmitzvat shelosha mevattelet gezerat shiva, kach mitzvat shiva mevattelet gezerat sheloshim.
Shiva? vehaanan shemona tenan! kasavar abba shaul: miktzat hayyom kechullo, veyom shevii ole lo lechan ulechan. amar rav chisda amar ravina bar shela: halacha keabba shaul.
Umodim chachamim leabba shaul keshechal shemini shello lihyot beshabbat erev haregel, shemmuttar legalleach beerev shabbat.
Keman azla ha deamar rav amram amar rav: avel, kevan sheamdu menachamin meetzlo, muttar birchitza? keman — keabba shaul.
Amar abbaye: halacha keabba shaul beyom shiva, umodim chachamim leabba shaul beyom sheloshim, deamrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo.
Rava amar: halacha keabba shaul beyom sheloshim, veen halacha keabba shaul beyom shiva. unehardae amri: halacha keabba shaul bazo uvazo, deamar shemuel: halacha kedivre hammekel beevel.
Sheloshim yom menalan? yalef "pera" "pera" minnazir. ketiv hacha: "rashechem al tifrau", uchetiv hatam: "gaddel pera sear rosho", ma lehallan sheloshim, af kan sheloshim.
Vehatam menalan? amar rav matna: setam nezirut — sheloshim yom, may tama? amar kera: "kadosh yihye", yihye begimatriyya telatin havu.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: hakkol modin keshechal shelishi shello lihyot erev haregel — sheasur birchitza ad haerev.

Amar rav nechemya bereh derav yehoshua: ashkachtinhu lerav pappe ulerav pappa deyatvi vekaamri: halacha kerav huna bereh derav yehoshua. ikka deamri, amar rav nechemya bereh derav yosef: ashkachtinhu lerav pappe ulerav pappa ulerav huna bereh derav yehoshua deyatvi vekaamri: hakkol modim sheim chal shelishi shello lihyot erev haregel — sheasur birchitza ad haerev.

Bea minneh abbaye merava: kevaro baregel, regel ole lo leminyan sheloshim, o en regel ole lo leminyan sheloshim? leminyan shiva la kamibbaya li, dela nahaga mitzvat shiva baregel. ki ka mibbaya li leminyan sheloshim, deka nahaga mitzvat sheloshim baregel, may?

Amar leh: eno ole. etiveh: hakkover et meto shene yamim kodem haregel — mone chamishsha yamim achar haregel, umelachto naaset al yede acherim, vaavadav veshifchotav osim betzina betoch beto, veen rabbim mitassekin immo,

a: Shekkevar nitasseku bo baregel. kelalo shel davar: kol shehu mishshum evel — regel mafsiko. vechol shehu mishshum iske rabbim — en regel mafsiko.

Kevaro shelosha yamim besof haregel — mone shiva achar haregel, arbaa yamim harishonim — rabbim mitassekin bo, shelosha yamim haacharonim — en rabbim mitassekin bo, shekkevar nitasseku [bo] baregel, veregel ole lo.
May lav — assefa! la, aresha.

Etiveh: regel ole lo leminyan sheloshim, ketzad? kevaro bitchillat haregel — mone shiva achar haregel, vmlachto naaset al yede acherim, vaavadav veshifchotav osin betzina betoch beto, veen rabbim mitassekin bo, shekkevar nitasseku bo baregel, veregel ole lo. teyuveta.
Ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yochanan: afillu kevaro baregel, vechen ori leh rabbi elazar lerabbi pedat bereh: afillu kevaro baregel.
Tanu rabbanan: kiyyem kefiyyayt hammitta shelosha yamim kodem haregel — eno tzarich lichpotah achar haregel, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim: afillu yom echad, afillu shaa achat.
Amar rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: hen hen divre bet shammay, hen hen divre bet hillel. shebbet shammay omrim: shelosha yamim, uvet hillel omrim: afillu yom echad.

Amar rav huna amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan, veamri la: amar leh rabbi yochanan lerabbi chiyyay bar abba ulerav huna: afillu yom echad, afillu shaa achat. rava amar: halacha ketanna didan deamar shelosha.
Ravina ikkela lesura difrat, amar leh rav chaviva leravina: hilcheta may? amar leh: afillu yom echad, vaafillu shaa achat.

Yatev rabbi chiyyay bar abba verabbi amme verabbi yitzchak nappacha akkila derabbi yitzchak ben elazar, nefak milleta mibbenayyhu: minnayin laavelut shiva — dichtiv: "vehafachti chaggechem leevel", ma chag shiva — af avelut shiva.

Veema atzeret, dechad yoma! hahu mibbee leh lechidresh lakish. deamar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yehuda nesia: minnayin lishmua rechoka sheenah noheget ella yom echad — dichtiv: "vehafachti chaggechem leevel", veashkechan atzeret deikkeri chad yoma chag.

Tanu rabbanan: shemua kerova — noheget shiva usheloshim, shemua rechoka — enah noheget ella yom echad. ezo hi kerova veezo hi rechoka? kerova betoch sheloshim, rechoka leachar sheloshim, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim: achat shemua kerova veachat shemua rechoka — noheget shiva usheloshim.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol makom sheatta motze yachid mekel verabbim machmirin — halacha karabbim. chutz mizzo, sheaf al pi sherabbi akiva mekel vachachamim machmirin — halacha kerabbi akiva. deamar shemuel: halacha kedivre hammekel beevel.

Rav chanina atya leh shemua daavu mibbe chozae, ata lekammeh derav chisda, amar leh: shemua rechoka enah noheget ella yom echad. rav natan bar amme ata leh shemua deimmeh mibbe chozae, ata lekammeh derava, amar leh: hare amru, shemua rechoka enah noheget ella yom echad bilvad.
Etiveh: bamma devarim amurim — bachamishsha mete mitzva, aval al aviv veal immo shiva usheloshim!

Amar leh: yechidaa hi, vela sevira lan kevoteh. detanya: maase umet aviv shel rabbi tzadok beginzak, vehodiuhu leachar shalosh shanim, uva veshaal et elisha ben avuya uzekenim sheimmo, veamru: nehog shiva usheloshim. ucheshemmet beno shel rabbi achiyyay baggola, yashav alav shiva usheloshim.
Ini? veha rav, bar achu derabbi chiyyay dehu bar achateh derabbi chiyyay, ki selek lehatam amar leh: abba kayyaym?
b: Amar leh: imma kayyemet? amar leh: imma kayyemet? amar leh: abba kayyaym? amar leh leshammaeh: chalotz li minalay, veholech acharay kelay levet hammerchatz.
Shema minna telat. shema minna — avel asur binilat hassandal, ushema minna — shemua rechoka enah noheget ella yom echad, ushema minna — miktzat hayyom kechullo!
Rabbi chiyyay lechud, rabbi achiyyay lechud.

Amar rabbi yose bar avin: shama shemua kerova baregel, ulemotzae haregel naaset rechoka — ola lo, veeno noheg ella yom echad. tane rabbi adda demin kesari kammeh derabbi yochanan: shama shemua kerova beshabbat, ulemotzae shabbat naaset rechoka — eno noheg ella yom echad.

Korea o eno korea? rabbi mani amar: eno korea, rabbi chanina amar: korea. amar leh rabbi mani lerabbi chanina: bishlama ledidi deamena eno korea, hayeynu dela ikka avelut shiva. ella ledidach deamrat korea — keria belo shiva mi ikka?
Vela?! vehatanya isi avu derabbi zera, veamri la achu derabbi zera kammeh derabbi zera: mi sheen lo chaluk likroa, venizdammen lo betoch shiva — korea. leachar shiva — eno korea.
Ani rabbi zera batreh: bamme devarim amurim — bachamishsha mete mitzva, aval al aviv veal immo — korea veholech!
Ki tanya hahi, lichvod aviv veimmo.

Tanu rabbanan: kol haamur befarashat kohanim shekkohen mittamme lahen — avel mitabbel alehen, veellu hen: ishto, aviv veimmo, achiv vaachoto, beno uvitto. hosifu alehen: achiv vaachoto habbetula meimmo, vaachoto nesua, ben meaviv ben meimmo.

Ucheshem shemmitabbel alehem — kach mitabbel al sheniyyim shellahem, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: eno mitabbel ella al ben beno veal avi aviv. vachachamim omrim: kol shemmitabbel alav, mitabbel immo.
Chachamim hayeynu tanna kamma? ikka benayyhu immo babbayit. ki ha deamar leh rav lechiyyay bereh, vechen amar leh rav huna lerabba bereh: beappa — nehog aviluta, bela appa — la tinhog aviluta.
Mar ukeva shechev leh bar chamu. sevar lemetav aleh shiva usheloshim, al rav huna legabbeh, ashkecheh, amar leh: tzudanyayta baet lemechal?! lo amru lichvod ishto — ella chamiv vachamoto.

Detanya: mi shemmet chamiv o chamoto — eno rashshay lachof et ishto lihyot kochelet velihyot pokeset, ella kofe mittato, venoheg immah avelut. vechen hi shemmet chamiha o chamotah — enah rashshaa lihyot kochelet velihyot pokeset, ella kofa mittatah venoheget immo avelut.

Vetanya iddach: af al pi sheamru eno rashshay lachof et ishto lihyot kochelet velihyot pokeset, beemet amru mozeget lo et hakkos, umatztzaat lo mitta, umarchetzet lo panav yadav veraglav. kashyayn ahadade!
Ella lav shema minna: kan bechamiv vachamoto, kan bishar kerovim. shema minna. tanya name hachi: lo amru lichvod ishto ella chamiv vachamoto bilvad.
Ammemar shachev leh bar bereh, kera illaveh. ata bereh — kera beappeh. iddechar dimyushshav kera, kam kera meummad.
Amar leh rav ashe leammemar: keria dimummad menalan? dichtiv: "vayyakom iyyov vayyikra et meilo".

a: Ella meatta: "veamad veamar lo chafatzti lekachtah", hacha name? veha tanya: ben yoshev ben omed ben mutte!
Amar leh: hatam la ketiv "veyaamod veyomar", hacha ketiv "vayyakom vayyikra".
Amar rame bar chama: minnayin likria shehi meummad, shenneemar: "vayyakom iyyov vayyikra". dilma milleta yattirta hu daavad? dei la tema hachi — "vayyagoz et rosho", hachi name?
Ella mehacha: "vayyakam hammelech vayyikra et begadav". vedilma milleta yattirta aved? dei la tema hachi — "vayyishkav artza", hachi name?
Vehatanya: yashav al gabbe mitta, al gabbe kisse, al gabbe udeyayni gedola, al gabbe karka — mikkullan lo yatza yede chovato. veamar rabbi yochanan: shello kiyyem kefiyyayt hammitta!
Amar leh: keen artza.

Tanu rabbanan, veellu devarim sheavel asur bahen: asur bimlacha uvirchitza uvesicha uvetashmish hammitta uvinilat hassandal. veasur likrot betora uvanneviim uvakketuvim, velishnot bammishna, bammidrash uvahalachot, uvattalmud uvaaggadot. veim hayu rabbim tzerichin lo — eno nimna. umaase umet beno shel rabbi yose betzippori, venichnas levet hammidrash, vedarash kol hayyom kullo.

Rabba bar bar chana itteraa beh milleta, savar dela lemippak lefirka. amar leh rabbi chanina: im hayu rabbim tzerichin lo — eno nimna. sevar leokome amora aleh. amar leh rav: tanya, uvilvad shello yaamid turegman.

Veella hechi aved? ki ha detanya: maase umet beno shel rabbi yehuda bar ilay, venichnas levet hammidrash. venichnas rabbi chananya ben akavya veyashav betziddo, velachash hu lerabbi chananya ben akavya, verabbi chananya ben akavya leturegman, veturegman hishmia larabbim.

Tanu rabbanan: avel, shelosha yamim harishonim — asur lehanniach tefillin, mishshelishi veelach, ushelishi bakkelal — muttar lehanniach tefillin. veim bau panim chadashot — eno choletz, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer: avel, shene yamim harishonim asur lehanniach tefillin. mishsheni, vesheni bakkelal — muttar lehanniach tefillin, veim bau panim chadashot — choletz.
Amar rav matna: may tama derabbi eliezer, dichtiv: "vayyittemu yeme vechi evel moshe". amar rav ena: may tama derabbi yehoshua, dichtiv: "veacharitah keyom mar".
Verabbi yehoshua name, ha ketiv: "vayyittemu yeme vegomer"! amar lach: shane moshe, detakkif evleh. verabbi eliezer name, ha ketiv: "veacharitah keyom mar"! ikkar merira chad yoma hu.
Amar ulla: halacha kerabbi eliezer bachalitza, vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua behannacha.
Ibbaya lehu: bashsheni leulla, choletz o eno choletz?
Ta shema, amar ulla: choletz umanniach afillu mea peamim. tanya name hachi, yehuda ben tema omer: choletz umanniach afillu mea peamim.
Rava amar: kevan shehinniach shuv eno choletz. veha rava hu deamar: halacha ketanna didan deamar shelosha!
b: Mitzva shane.
Tanu rabbanan: avel, shelosha yamim harishonim asur bimlacha, vaafillu ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaka. mikkan veelach — ose betzina betoch beto. vehaishsha tova bappelech betoch betah.
Tanu rabbanan: avel, shelosha yamim harishonim eno holech levet haevel, mikkan veelach holech, veeno yoshev bimkom hamenachamin, ella bimkom hammitnachamin.
Tanu rabbanan: avel, shelosha yamim harishonim asur bishelat shalom. mishshelosha vead shiva — meshiv veeno shoel. mikkan veelach, shoel umeshiv kedarko.
Shelosha yamim harishonim asur bishelat shalom? vehatanya: maase umetu banav shel rabbi akiva, nichnesu kol yisrael vehispidum hesped gadol.

Bishat petiratan, amad rabbi akiva al safsal gadol veamar: achenu bet yisrael shimu! afillu shene vanim chatanim — menucham hu bishvil kavod sheasitem. veim bishvil akiva batem, hare kamma akiva bashshuk. ella kach amartem: torat elohav belibbo. vechol shekken shessecharchem kaful, lechu levattechem leshalom!
Kevod rabbim shane.
Mishshelosha vead shiva — meshiv veeno shoel, mikkan veelach, shoel umeshiv kedarko.
Ureminhu: hammotze et chavero avel, betoch sheloshim yom — medabber immo tanchumin veeno shoel bishlomo, leachar sheloshim yom — shoel bishlomo veeno medabber immo tanchumin.
Meta ishto venasa ishsha acheret, eno rashshay likkanes leveto ledabber immo tanchumin. metzao bashshuk — omer lo besafa rafa uvechoved rosh.
Amar rav idi bar avin: hu shoel bishlom acherim — sheacherim sheruyin beshalom, acherim en shoalin bishlomo, shehu eno sharuy beshalom.
Veha middekatane meshiv, mikkelal deshayylinan leh? dela yadi.
I hachi, hatam name! hatam — moda lehu vela mahdar lehu, hacha — la tzarich leodoinhu.

Ureminhu: hammotze et chavero avel, betoch shenem asar chodesh — medabber immo tanchumin, veeno shoel bishlomo. leachar shenem asar chodesh — shoel bishlomo, veeno medabber immo tanchumin, aval medabber immo min hatztzad.

Amar rabbi meir: hammotze et chavero avel leachar shenem asar chodesh, umedabber immo tanchumin, lema hu dome? leadam shennishbera raglo vechayta, metzao rofe veamar lo: kelach etzli sheani shovrah vaarappeenna, kede shetteda shessammanin shelli yafin!
La kashya: ha beaviv veimmo, ha bishar kerovim.
Hatam name, yedabber immo tanchumin min hatztzad? in hachi name. umay eno medabber immo tanchumin — kedarko, aval medabber immo min hatztzad.

Tanu rabbanan: avel, shelosha yamim harishonim, ba mimmakom karov — mone immahen, ba mimmakom rachok — mone leatzmo. mikkan veelach, afillu ba mimmakom karov — mone leatzmo. rabbi shimon omer: afillu ba beyom hashshevii mimmakom karov — mone immahen.
Amar mar: shelosha yamim harishonim, ba mimmakom karov — mone immahen. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: vehu sheyyesh gedol habbayit babbayit.
Ibbaya lehu:
